jobs.description:
**Position / Title:** Project Planner

**Location:** Downey, CA (In-Person)

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**About The Company:**

Farwest Corrosion Control is a leading provider of corrosion control, cathodic protection, and infrastructure solutions supporting energy, utility, and pipeline systems across the Western United States. With decades of industry experience, Farwest plays a critical role in protecting and maintaining essential infrastructure. The company operates with a strong safety-first culture, hands-on leadership, and a reputation for delivering high-quality, technically sound work.

* Own the planning and permitting process across 50–100+ active utility and infrastructure projects
* Serve as the key point of coordination between internal teams, power companies, and municipal agencies
* Ensure all projects are fully scoped, permitted, and ready for field execution
* Operate with strong attention to detail and high accountability in a fast-paced environment
* Communicate proactively with utilities, municipalities, and internal stakeholders
* Stay organized and structured while managing a high volume of concurrent projects
* Projects are consistently permitted, planned, and released to the field without delays
* Strong working relationships are built with power companies and local agencies
* Field teams are set up for efficient execution with accurate layouts and complete documentation
* Be part of a specialized, technically respected infrastructure company
* Work on critical utility and pipeline projects that directly impact communities
* High ownership role with visibility across operations
* Opportunity to grow into Project Management or Operations leadership
* Stable backlog of work with long-term clients in energy and utilities
* Company vehicle provided

**A Little Bit About the Team You Will Be Working With:**

You will work closely with Project Managers, Superintendents, and field crews to support planning and execution. This role also partners heavily with power companies, city agencies, and permitting offices, making you a key connector between office, field, and external stakeholders.

**Must Have Qualifications:**

* Experience reading and interpreting construction drawings (civil and/or electrical)
* **Experience obtaining permits and coordinating with municipalities or utility companies**
* Ability to manage a high volume of projects simultaneously (50–100+)
* **Clean driving record and valid driver’s license**
* Willingness to travel locally with occasional overnight stays

**Nice to Have Qualifications:**

* Experience coordinating with power companies for electrical service requests
* **Background in utility, energy, oil & gas, or infrastructure construction**
* **Field experience (trenching, layout, or hands-on construction exposure)**
* Experience using SmartSheets or similar project tracking tools

**Education Requirement / Certifications:**

* High School Diploma or equivalent required **Construction Management, Engineering, or related field is a plus**

**Must Have Soft Skills:**

* Highly organized with strong attention to detail
* **Strong communication and coordination skills**
* Ability to multitask and manage competing priorities
* **Task-oriented with strong follow-through**
* Professional and collaborative demeanor

**Day to Day Duties / Technology:**

* Develop site layouts and assist with project planning documentation
* **Coordinate with power companies and municipal agencies for electrical service requirements**
* Review plans and obtain permits for construction projects
* **Conduct site visits to take measurements and verify job conditions**
* Attend job walks, pre-bid meetings, and planning discussions
* **Track project schedules, milestones, and documentation**
* Maintain organized project files and assist with closeout

**Technology:** **Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook)**  SmartSheets or similar tools

**Web-based permitting and utility coordination platforms**

**Shift / Schedule:**

* Monday – Friday **Standard business hours (in-office)**

**Pay Rate Range:**

* $22.00 – $27.00+ per hour (DOE, flexibility for strong candidates)

**Compliance Needed:**

* Clean MVR **Valid Driver’s License**  Ability to pass background check

**Benefits for Full Time Employees:**

* Health, Dental, Vision Insurance **401(k)**  Paid Time Off (PTO) and holidays **Long-term career growth opportunities**

**Equipment / Training / Travel:**

* Company vehicle provided
* **Training on internal systems and processes**
* Travel throughout Southern California
* **Occasional overnight travel**

Pay: $22.00 - $27.00 per hour

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Downey, CA 90241

CLMI Group is looking for passionate construction and program management professionals to join our team! We value ambition, dedication, and innovation, and believe in building a network of talented individuals who share our commitment to making a difference.

**Position Title:** Project Coordinator IV (Sustainability)

**Location:** Los Angeles Community College District – Program Management Office (PMO), Los Angeles, CA. Candidates must be willing and able to work at any assigned LACCD college or site location and make site visits as project needs require.

**Position Description:**

This position is bond-eligible and is strictly limited to work associated with capital construction, modernization, and sustainability projects as defined under the BuildLACCD Bond Program. Duties performed under this position shall not include routine maintenance, repair, or operational tasks that fall within the responsibilities of facilities Maintenance & Operations (M&O). The scope of this role is exclusively tied to bond-eligible activities such as planning, design, construction, commissioning, and related project management functions necessary to deliver capital improvements consistent with LACCD’s Capital Construction Bond Program requirements and legal limitations governing bond fund expenditures.

The Project Coordinator IV – Sustainability provides project coordination, cost management, and financial controls support to the BuildLACCD Sustainability Strike Team throughout the planning, scoping, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout of sustainability and energy-related capital improvement projects across the Los Angeles Community College District (LACCD). Working under the direction of the Sustainability Strike Team Lead, this position supports the Strike Team Cost Analyst and Project Managers, and coordinates with District personnel, Campus Administration, College Project Teams (CPTs), the Program Management Office (PMO), Program Controls, and other stakeholders to support project budget development, funding verification, cost forecasting, financial reporting, and project establishment.

The position supports Districtwide sustainability initiatives, including Energy Information Systems (EIS), the Sustainability and Climate Action Roadmap, Building Management Systems (BMS), Central Plant and Local Building Decarbonization, Central Plant optimization, LED lighting upgrades, energy efficiency retrofits, renewable energy systems, Photovoltaic (PV) systems, microgrids, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure, electrification, and other sustainability-related capital improvement projects.

* Provide day-to-day project coordination, cost management, and financial controls support to the Strike Team Cost Analyst, Project Managers, and the Sustainability Strike Team throughout the project lifecycle.
* Prepare, organize, and maintain project management documents, records, correspondence, reports, and other project-related communications.
* Support project establishment and White Paper development by coordinating financial documentation, funding verification, preliminary budgets, cost estimates, and required reviews in accordance with established BuildLACCD PMO Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Coordinate with District personnel, CPTs, PMO, Program Controls, and other stakeholders to verify project budgets, available funding, cost estimates, forecasts, and financial requirements.
* Coordinate with CPTs and PMO Cost Analysts to support budget establishment, monitoring, budget transfers, and accurate financial reporting.
* Develop and maintain cost forecasts and Estimates-to-Complete (ETCs); track Change Order Requests (CORs), commitments, and funding availability.
* Monitor project budgets, expenditures, contract balances, remaining encumbrances, funding availability, and financial risks to identify potential shortfalls before they affect project delivery.
* Work with PMO Cost Analysts to verify the accuracy and integrity of project budgets and financial forecasts in accordance with established cost management procedures.
* Participate in change management and risk assessment meetings to identify cost-related trends, risks, exposures, and potential mitigation strategies.
* Perform monthly budget and cost reconciliations to support accurate month-end reporting, and review expenditures across multiple funding sources.
* Coordinate with scheduling teams to assess cash flow and schedule performance impacts on costs, including variances, overruns, underruns, and forecasting concerns.
* Review financial reports, cost performance, and progress data; communicate material variances and potential financial risks to Project Managers and appropriate stakeholders.
* Track contract Periods of Performance (POP), contract balances, remaining encumbrances, and available funding.
* Coordinate invoice oversight and reconciliation with accounting and project stakeholders to support timely and accurate payment processing.
* Collaborate with PMO to validate project budget data, support stakeholder dashboards, and maintain accurate program controls databases and financial reports.

* Perform other bond-eligible project cost management and coordination duties as directed by the Sustainability Strike Team Lead.

jobs.description:
**Position Title:** IT/AV Project Coordinator

**Department:** IT/AV Services

**IT/AV Project Coordinator - Job Summary**

Golden Star Technology (GST) is seeking an experienced **Project Coordinator** to support the successful delivery of **IT infrastructure, low-voltage, audiovisual (AV), unified communications, and technology deployment projects**. This role serves as the primary liaison between clients, internal teams, subcontractors, and project stakeholders to ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and according to scope.

The ideal candidate has strong experience coordinating multiple projects, conducting **site surveys and on-site project visits**, managing project documentation, tracking schedules, and supporting cross-functional technical teams. Experience within the **IT, AV, structured cabling, low-voltage, or technology integration industry** is highly preferred.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate and manage multiple IT, AV, and technology projects from initiation through completion.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, internal teams, vendors, and project stakeholders.
* Conduct **site surveys, field assessments, and on-site project visits** to gather requirements, evaluate project readiness, and support successful execution.
* Participate in project kickoff meetings and assist with project planning activities.
* Develop and maintain project schedules, timelines, resource plans, and status reports.
* Track project milestones, deliverables, budgets, risks, and action items.
* Coordinate project resources, subcontractors, vendors, and equipment deliveries.
* Monitor project performance to ensure scope, quality, budget, and timeline objectives are achieved.
* Collect, document, and manage business and technical requirements.
* Create and maintain project documentation, including project plans, meeting notes, change requests, closeout packages, and final project deliverables.
* Conduct quality assurance reviews and support project acceptance processes.
* Facilitate project status meetings and provide regular updates to stakeholders.
* Coordinate end-user training and project handoffs as needed.

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum **5 years of experience** in Project Coordination, Project Management, Account Management, or a similar role supporting enterprise technology projects.
* Experience managing or coordinating **IT, AV, audiovisual, low-voltage, structured cabling, network infrastructure, or technology deployment projects**.
* **Required:** Experience conducting **site surveys, field assessments, job walks, and on-site project visits**.
* Strong understanding of project lifecycle management, scheduling, documentation, and resource coordination.
* Experience working with clients, vendors, subcontractors, and cross-functional technical teams.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Strong organizational, multitasking, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience tracking project budgets, schedules, deliverables, and project risks.
* PMP certification or formal project management training is a plus.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Competitive salary
* Medical / Dental / Vision coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Paid vacation
* Additional company perks

**About GST**

Founded in 1985 and headquartered in Cerritos, CA, Golden Star Technology (GST) is a leading provider of IT and AV solutions, serving businesses, enterprise organizations, educational institutions, and government agencies nationwide. Through strategic partnerships with industry-leading technology manufacturers, GST delivers innovative solutions, customized services, and exceptional customer support.

Recognized by the Los Angeles Business Journal as one of LA's Best Places to Work for seven consecutive years, GST has also earned numerous industry awards and accolades for excellence, growth, innovation, and customer service. Our success is driven by a commitment to teamwork, integrity, accountability, and continuous professional development.

Learn more at **www.gstinc.com**

**Join us and be part of a team that drives innovation and excellence in IT/AV solutions!**

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**

The Program Coordinator supports the Volunteer Center's headquarters in Torrance, working closely with staff, volunteers, schools, businesses, and community partners to implement programs that make a meaningful difference in the lives of local children and families.

This position plays an important role in bringing the Volunteer Center's mission to life through the coordination of community programs, volunteer activities, and partnerships. With a primary focus on **Food For Kids, Operation Teddy Bear, and corporate and group volunteer activations**, the Program Coordinator helps connect people and resources to community needs while ensuring programs operate smoothly and effectively.

The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, personable, and passionate about community service. This hands-on, collaborative role offers opportunities to build relationships, lead meaningful volunteer experiences, and contribute directly to the well-being of the communities we serve.

**Key ResponsibilitiesProgram Coordination & Operations**

* Coordinate and support the implementation of the Volunteer Center's community programs, primarily Food For Kids and Operation Teddy Bear, ensuring activities align with organizational goals and community needs.
* Oversee day-to-day program operations, including resource management, inventory, logistics, and preparation for ongoing and seasonal activities.
* Plan and coordinate program activities, distributions, and special projects to ensure successful execution and timely completion.
* Collaborate with staff, volunteers, schools, and community partners to support program delivery and create meaningful experiences for participants.
* Build and maintain relationships with community partners, donors, and participating organizations to strengthen program reach and effectiveness.
* Monitor program needs, maintain accurate documentation, and ensure activities meet established guidelines, reporting requirements, and deadlines.
* Identify opportunities to improve program efficiency, strengthen volunteer engagement, and expand the Volunteer Center's impact in the community.

**Corporate and Group Volunteer Activations**

* Plan and lead volunteer activities for corporate partners, schools, and community organizations.
* Respond promptly to group inquiries, identify appropriate opportunities, and coordinate participation.
* Manage event logistics, including scheduling, supplies, space preparation, instructions, and setup.
* Welcome groups and share engaging presentations about the Volunteer Center's mission, programs, and community impact.
* Provide hands-on leadership to ensure activities are organized, meaningful, and productive.

* Collaborate with the Volunteer Coordinator and staff to identify volunteer needs and develop opportunities.
* Track volunteer participation, hours, and outcomes; assist with follow-up communications.

**Program Administration and Reporting**

* Maintain accurate records of program activities, distributions, donations, inventory, volunteers, and outcomes.
* Complete assigned sections of the Monthly Program Report accurately and on time.
* Collect data for grant reports, annual reports, audits, and program evaluations.
* Maintain organized program files, calendars, contact lists, and procedures.
* Monitor expenditures, inventory needs, and deadlines with the Director of Programs.
* Identify challenges, recommend solutions, and support program improvements.

**Community Engagement and Partnerships**

* Represent the Volunteer Center professionally with volunteers, donors, schools, businesses, and community partners.
* Respond to program inquiries promptly and professionally.
* Develop and maintain relationships with community partners to support program needs.
* Conduct program tours, orientations, and presentations for volunteers, donors, and community groups.
* Collaborate with staff to connect individuals and groups with appropriate volunteer opportunities.

* Experience in program coordination, nonprofit operations, volunteer management, community engagement, event planning, logistics, or a related field.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to independently manage projects and deadlines.
* Excellent communication, customer service, and relationship-building skills.
* Demonstrated initiative, problem-solving abilities, and attention to detail.
* Ability to lead and work effectively with volunteers, partners, and staff.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace, spreadsheets, and office software.
* Ability to maintain accurate records, track data, and complete reports.
* Flexibility, adaptability, and commitment to the Volunteer Center's mission.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with nonprofit programs, food assistance, school-based programs, or community distributions.
* Experience coordinating corporate volunteers or large-scale events.
* Familiarity with Salesforce, HandsOn Connect, or similar systems.
* Experience with inventory management, donations, or grant reporting.
* Knowledge of South Bay, Harbor, and Long Beach communities; bilingual skills are a plus.

**Physical, Travel, and Scheduling Requirements**

* Availability for occasional evenings and weekends to support events and program activities.
* Flexibility to accommodate changing schedules and seasonal program needs.

jobs.title: Event Operations Manager, Los Angeles
jobs.description:
**CURATE GROUP**

**Role:** Event Operations Manager, Lumos Experiences

**Reports to**: Head of Regional Events, Los Angeles

**Contract Type**: Full time 3:2

**Office Location:** Los Angeles area

**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

Curate Group is a dynamic events and experiences company, creating unforgettable moments that bring people together. We specialize in unique, high-quality live events - from large scale festivals, immersive concerts, cultural experiences and corporate events partnering with some of the world’s most exciting brands.

One of our core event brands, Lumos Experiences, is one of the most distinctive live entertainment concepts, creating atmospheric candlelit concerts that transform unexpected spaces into something genuinely magical. We're growing fast, running multiple shows per week across new cities and countries and we're looking for a highly organized **Event Operations Manager** to support the ongoing running of our shows.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

Lumos is scaling rapidly across Los Angeles and we're looking for an experienced **Event Operations Manager** to lead the successful delivery of our live events. You'll own operational planning and execution across multiple venues, ensuring every show runs smoothly, safely and consistently while supporting the continued growth of the business.

This role suits someone who takes real pride in their work and spots what needs doing before being asked. You'll be a proactive problem-solver who thrives on responsibility, makes confident decisions and brings both energy and precision to everything you do. This isn't a role for someone who waits to be directed, it's for someone who leads, cares and makes things happen.

You'll also spend time at some of the shows because the best operations leaders stay close to the experience they're delivering. Seeing your events firsthand allows you to coach teams, identify improvements and continually raise standards across the region.

**SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE**

Success in this role will be measured through event quality, operational consistency, staffing performance, wise budget management, positive guest feedback and the ability to support the region's continued growth.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **End-to-End Event Operations:** Own the full operational delivery of our shows across Los Angeles and surrounding regions, from pre-show planning and venue coordination to on-the-ground execution and post-event review, ensuring every event runs smoothly, on-brand and to a high standard.

* Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to multitask.
* Excellent negotiation, communication and interpersonal skills.
* Budget management experience.
* Driving license, traveling to various locations as needed.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

jobs.description:
**About the Company**

Nitrogen Express is a family-owned industrial and specialty gas distribution business. We supply businesses that need gases and related products to keep their operations running. We earn revenue by selling and delivering products and by keeping customers invoiced, collected, and serviced reliably.

**About the Position**

We need one accountable, in-office owner for the company’s day-to-day financial administration and office operating rhythm. The work is important to cash flow, vendor relationships, customer experience, and good decision-making. We want to replace fragmented processes with reliable systems—not just fill a desk.

This is a high-visibility seat in a stable, family-owned business where a capable person can make a real difference. The person will not be stuck doing one narrow transaction all day. They will own meaningful financial workflows, work directly with the owner, improve how the business operates, and build systems that matter. It is an excellent opportunity for someone who is tired of being buried in a large company or limited to a narrow AP/AR silo and wants broader responsibility.

**Responsibilities**

This person should own the day-to-day financial workflows for a small operating business, with appropriate owner review and approval on major decisions and payments.

* Maintain clean, timely QuickBooks Online records and supporting documentation.
* Drive invoicing promptly and accurately; identify missing information before it creates a billing delay.
* Own the accounts-receivable rhythm: aging review, professional customer follow-up, notes, escalation, and collections follow-through.
* Organize accounts payable: receive and code bills, maintain vendor files, prepare a clear weekly payables list, and make sure nothing important is missed. Owner approval remains required for payments.
* Support bank and credit-card reconciliations, month-end readiness, and clear financial reporting for the owner and outside accounting support.
* Create, document, and maintain practical SOPs for invoicing, collections, payables, customer account setup, and file management.
* Use Excel, QuickBooks, and secure AI-enabled tools thoughtfully to reduce manual work, catch errors, create follow-up drafts, improve reporting, and make processes more reliable.
* Serve as a dependable, professional in-office point of contact for customers, vendors, and the team.

**First 30 / 60 / 90 days**

* Learn the business, customer/payment cycles, QuickBooks structure, vendors, and current workflow.
* Take control of the AR aging and open-payables visibility.
* Identify immediate invoicing, collections, and file-organization gaps.
* Establish a weekly owner-facing cash, receivables, and payables rhythm.

* Implement a consistent invoice-to-collection process and documented collection cadence.
* Clean up vendor, customer, and supporting-document workflows.
* Create clear SOPs for the highest-risk recurring tasks.
* Present the first practical automation / process-improvement recommendations.

* Deliver reliable recurring reporting to the owner.
* Show improved visibility into AR aging, invoicing status, and upcoming payables.
* Complete at least two meaningful workflow improvements that reduce manual rework or missed follow-up.
* Deliver a prioritized next-step plan for stronger controls, reporting, and sensible use of AI.

**What success looks like**

* Success is not just “the books are entered.” The right person makes the financial side of the business feel organized, current, and visible. Invoices go out on time, collections are handled professionally and consistently, vendor obligations are clear, records are easy to find, and the owner can see what needs attention without chasing information.

Qualifications

* At least 3 years of relevant hands-on accounting/finance-office experience.
* Recent hands-on experience with QuickBooks and the end-to-end cycle of invoicing, AR/collections, AP, vendor bills, and financial organization—not only one narrow task in a large department.
* QuickBooks Online, Excel, bank/credit-card reconciliation, billing, receivables, collections, payables, and basic reporting.
* Experience in a small owner-led B2B business such as distribution, industrial supply, logistics, field service, construction supply, equipment rental/repair, manufacturing support, or a similar operational environment.
* A practical, privacy-conscious use of AI and automation. The candidate should be able to name specific workflows improved with AI or automation and explain how they protected customer and financial information.
* Comfortable making courteous but firm collections calls and documenting commitments.
* A demonstrated record of identifying a problem, creating a usable process, following through, and communicating clearly with an owner, customers, vendors, and teammates.
* The person must want to work in the office five days per week and have a realistic commute.

No CPA or bachelor’s degree is required if the person can demonstrate the actual skills, judgment, and ownership required for the job. A bookkeeping or QuickBooks certification is a plus, not a substitute for proven work.

Compensation and Benefits

* $52,000–$58,000, depending on proven ownership of the full workflow and the ability to improve systems.

jobs.title: Marketing Communications Graphic Design Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Bobrick**

Headquartered in North Hollywood, CA, Bobrick is a global leader in stainless steel commercial washroom accessories with more than 100 years of innovation. Founded in 1906, Bobrick pioneered the world's first lavatory-mounted soap dispenser and has grown into a mid-sized, privately owned enterprise with trusted brands like Koala Kare. Today, Bobrick operates eight manufacturing facilities across the U.S., Canada, the U.K., and India, serving customers in over 125 countries worldwide.

**Job Summary**

The Marketing Communications and Design Specialist creates and maintains technical collateral and digital product content for Bobrick Washroom Accessories, Bobrick Toilet Partitions, Koala Kare, and GAMCO. This role combines graphic design with accurate content management to support product launches and marketing initiatives.

Working with Product Management, Digital Marketing, the Marketing Communications team, and vendors, the specialist delivers clear, approved materials that meet brand standards and deadlines. The specialist also develops and maintains website and email components using HTML and CSS, translating approved designs into responsive digital content and resolving routine front-end issues across Bobrick’s digital platforms.

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

*Technical product communications*

* Create, revise, and maintain technical data sheets, installation instructions, customer service documents, service and parts manuals, technical bulletins, maintenance guides, product labels, carton imprint layouts, country of origin documentation, warranties, and short and long form guide specifications.
* Coordinate technical reviews and approvals with Product Management.

*Graphic design and production*

* Design and format technical collateral; update existing sell sheets, brochures, continuing education presentations, and training materials; and produce business cards using approved templates.
* Apply sound typography, layout, and visual hierarchy to make materials clear and consistent with brand standards.
* Edit and prepare product imagery for print and digital use.

*Product launch support*

* Follow established launch processes and checklists to coordinate required collateral, product information, images, specifications, and digital assets.
* Track deliverables, reviews, and approvals to meet launch timelines.

*Website content and product resources*

* Build and maintain product pages, landing pages, and reusable content components in WordPress or the applicable content management system
* Write and modify HTML and CSS to implement approved designs, create responsive layouts, and resolve routine front-end issues.
* Test changes across browsers and screen sizes, check accessibility and functionality, and document and escalate changes that require developer support.
* Keep approved copy, imagery, downloads, and links current across brand websites, Bobrick Resources, the Technical Reference Library, and ATS/Bobrick Digital Spec Builder.
* Add or replace approved assets and coordinate removal of obsolete or discontinued product content.

*BIM and CAD coordination*

* Coordinate requests, revisions, reviews, approvals, and publication of Revit (.rfa) and CAD (.dwg) files.
* Work with Product Managers and technical vendors to maintain accurate, organized product assets.

*Email marketing*

* Build, maintain, and troubleshoot HubSpot email templates using HTML and inline CSS.
* Adapt templates for campaign needs, prepare mailing lists, and support trade show and other marketing campaigns.
* Test formatting across desktop and mobile devices, and check links and content before deployment in coordination with Digital Marketing.

*Translations and print production*

* Coordinate translation requests, vendor revisions, and internal reviews; incorporate approved translations into print and digital materials.
* Manage collateral reprints with print vendors, checking artwork, proofs, and file versions before production.

*Project coordination and quality control*

* Manage concurrent assignments, maintain organized source files and version control, and check accuracy and brand consistency before publication.
* Adapt communications to architects, designers, specifiers, facility managers, and distributors.

jobs.description:
**PART-TIME • HOURLY BASE PAY + COMMISSION • OPPORTUNITY TO GROW INTO FULL-TIME**

Northwest LK Media & Signage is hiring an Outside Sales Representative to help local businesses with commercial signs, graphics, printing, branded spaces and trade show displays, as well as related marketing and video projects.

PAY & WORK ARRANGEMENT

* Base pay: $20–$36 per hour, based on experience and qualifications, plus additional commission on closed sales.

* Part-time: approximately 16–20 hours per week, Monday–Friday, coordinated around outreach, client meetings and business events.

* Based in Irvine, serving local business clients in Orange County and Southern California. Hybrid work includes remote tasks, in-office collaboration and local client visits. This is not a fully remote role.

* Opportunity to transition to full-time based on performance, business needs and company growth.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Help business owners turn storefront openings, renovations, brand updates and events into practical signage and marketing projects. You will develop new B2B accounts and work with our creative, production and project teams on proposals. This role includes cold outreach and finding new customers, as well as consistent follow-up through the sale.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

* Identify and contact prospective business clients through calls, email, LinkedIn, referrals, local visits and networking.

* Meet business owners, property managers and other decision-makers to understand their signage, graphics, printing and marketing needs.

* Coordinate proposals and quotes with internal teams, respond to client questions and follow opportunities through to a closed sale.

* Maintain organized prospect records, next steps and follow-up schedules.

* Build repeat business and referrals through reliable client communication.

WHAT YOU BRING

* Clear, professional English communication, good listening skills and confidence speaking with prospective customers.

* Willingness to initiate outreach and follow up consistently.

* Ability to organize your own prospecting and coordinate with a team.

* Availability for local client meetings and the agreed part-time schedule.

HELPFUL, BUT NOT REQUIRED

B2B sales, outside sales, account development or other customer-facing experience. Backgrounds in signage, printing, advertising, marketing, construction, real estate or related business services are welcome. Existing local business contacts and industry experience are advantages, not requirements. We welcome applicants with transferable experience who are comfortable developing new business.

TO APPLY

Submit your resume through Indeed. You may also briefly share your available workdays and an example of a customer relationship or sales opportunity you developed. No cover letter is required.

Pay: $20.00 - $36.00 per hour

Expected hours: 16.0 – 20.0 per week

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Irvine, CA 92612

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

The Program Coordinator leads day-to-day planning, implementation, and documentation of Eden Youth’s integrated youth substance use prevention portfolio, including scheduling and partnerships with districts and school sites. Current programs include Friday Night Live (FNL) chapters, Stanford REACH Lab prevention curricula (such as Smart Talk, opioid/fentanyl awareness, Our Healthy Futures, and age-appropriate vape-free education), and the Familia Adelante curriculum and family workshops. The Coordinator aligns program delivery with school calendars, grant requirements, evaluation protocols, and the Senior Program Manager’s priorities, and incorporates youth voice throughout. The position also supervises, trains, and coaches facilitators and peer educators. This is a prevention role; it does not provide substance use disorder diagnosis or clinical treatment.

**JOB FUNCTIONS AND ESSENTIAL DUTIES**

**School partnerships and implementation**

Serve as the primary liaison between schools, districts, staff, and community partners to coordinate program planning, approvals, scheduling, referrals, and implementation. Ensure culturally responsive, age-appropriate, and accessible services across middle and high schools, including seasonal programming. Maintain site trackers to monitor attendance, program delivery, evaluations, staffing, challenges, and follow-up actions while supporting partnership agreements and renewals.

**Stanford REACH Lab curricula and appropriate intervention**

Coordinate the effective delivery of Stanford REACH Lab substance-use prevention curricula, including cannabis, vaping, opioid/fentanyl awareness, and alternatives to suspension. Schedule and support trained educators, monitor curriculum fidelity, and address implementation concerns. Collaborate with school teams to manage referrals, ensure confidential student support, and coordinate pre/post-surveys using approved Stanford data collection tools.

**Friday Night Live and youth leadership**

Coordinate Friday Night Live (FNL) chapters, youth leadership meetings, prevention campaigns, and school activities while promoting youth participation and ownership. Collaborate with the Youth Advisory Council (YAC) on youth-led projects, community outreach, and advocacy. Train and mentor youth leaders in communication, project planning, inclusive leadership, prevention messaging, and responsible reporting.

**Familia Adelante and caregiver engagement**

Coordinate culturally responsive Familia Adelante workshops and caregiver education in partnership with schools, families, and bilingual facilitators. Manage outreach, scheduling, translation and interpretation, registration, attendance, and follow-up while maintaining confidentiality. Ensure county-funded program requirements are met and documented separately from other funded activities.

**Enhanced Care Management (ECM) and Community Health Connections**

Introduce ECM and Community Connect services to school counselors, family engagement staff, and student support teams. Identify potential referral opportunities for students and families experiencing complex health or social needs. Coordinate referrals to staff for Medi-Cal and CYBHI eligibility verification, assessment, and enrollment determination. Support connections to behavioral health services, and other community programs. Follow up on referral coordination while maintaining confidentiality and respecting family consent.

**Deliverables, evaluation, and contract compliance**

Maintain funder-specific work plans, documentation, and reporting to ensure contract compliance and prevent duplicate billing or reporting. Coordinate accurate data collection, timely submissions, evaluations, and quality assurance. Support county reporting deadlines, annual prevention planning, stakeholder feedback, and continuous program improvement. Collaborate with management and partners to fulfill prevention and youth engagement deliverables.

**Team coordination, safety, and professionalism**

Provide guidance, onboarding, and coaching to peer educators, youth specialists, and interns while collaborating with supervisors to support team development, staffing needs, and program effectiveness. Ensure compliance with mandated reporting, youth safety, district policies, confidentiality, and trauma-informed practices. Participate in required professional development to maintain program quality and professionalism.

Strong organizational, coordination, and facilitation skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, multiple school sites, and concurrent program deadlines.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with students, families, school personnel, staff, and community partners.

Exercises sound judgment, makes well-reasoned decisions, and develops practical solutions to operational and program-related challenges.

Demonstrates adaptability, embraces responsible organizational change, and supports continuous improvement in alignment with the organization's mission.

Maintains a results-oriented approach, follows through on commitments, and consistently meets established deadlines and performance expectations.

Demonstrates active listening, cultural humility, and respect for diverse perspectives while modeling inclusive and professional behavior.

Demonstrates accountability, ethical conduct, professionalism, and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a team.

Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience, with at least two years coordinating youth, school-based, prevention, or community programs.

We're the kind of place that's ranked #1 on G2 in our category and named a Great Place to Work™ by our own team. jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
Pool service owners run crews, routes, customers and billing, often on paper and late at night. Chisel Tide puts all of it in one place: scheduling, routes, invoicing and payments, with AI that handles the routine office work.

Chisel owns and operates pool service companies, and Tide is built alongside them. When you call an owner, you're selling something made by people who run the same kind of business.

We're hiring an SDR to get Tide in front of more pool service owners. You'll call them, learn how they run things, and book meetings with the ones Tide can help. If you've worked at a pool distributor, serviced pools, or run a service office, you already speak the language. No software sales experience needed.

**The job**
-----------

* Call pool service owners. This is a phone job: plan on 100 dials a day.
* Learn how they handle scheduling, routes, billing and customer communication.
* Explain Tide in plain terms and spot the businesses it fits.
* Book qualified meetings and demos, make sure the owner shows up, and hand the sales team clear notes on what they need and the next step.
* Follow up with owners who aren't ready yet.
* Keep the CRM accurate.
* Bring back what you hear from owners so we can sell and build Tide better.

You'll work from a researched, enriched list of target businesses, so your time goes into conversations, not list building.

**How we measure it**
---------------------

The right owner shows up, there's a real need, and the next step is clear. At full ramp the target is 10+ qualified meetings a month, and ramp takes 4 weeks. You'll always know the number and how you're tracking against it.

**Your first month**
--------------------

Product walkthroughs, demo shadowing and practice calls, then supported outreach. Weekly call reviews with the team in our San Francisco office. By the end of the month you own your account list.

**Where it goes**
-----------------

Strong SDRs move into Account Executive roles, typically within 9-12 months. Along the way you'll work with product and onboarding, so you'll understand the whole business, not just the first call.

**What you bring**
------------------

* You pick up the phone and you follow through.
* You're curious about how small businesses actually run.
* You ask good questions and listen to the answers.
* You take feedback and get better fast.
* You're comfortable learning new software.

Experience in pool service, distribution, inside sales or customer service is a real plus.

**The interview**
-----------------

You'll explain Tide to a pool service owner who still schedules on paper and sends invoices at night. We'll give you feedback and you'll try again. We're looking at how you communicate, the questions you ask, and how quickly you adjust. Nobody expects you to know Tide yet.

**Pay and benefits**
--------------------

* $60,000 base salary.
* $20,000 commission at target, for $80,000 OTE. Uncapped + accelerators above target. You'll get the written plan, including how ramp works, before you accept.
* Health, dental, vision.
* In-office in San Francisco.

**Apply**
---------

Share your resume and tell us about any pool, sales or customer-facing experience, and something you worked hard to accomplish.

Chisel Industries is an equal opportunity employer.

**Position Summary:**

Kith is seeking an IT Project & Operations Coordinator to support the execution of technology initiatives across our

retail, corporate, and e-commerce operations. This role sits at the intersection of project coordination and day-to-

day IT operations, with a strong emphasis on supporting new store openings and construction build-outs -

candidate is organized, proactive, detail oriented, and comfortable working across construction schedules, vendor

jobs.description:
**About Daysee**

Daysee is a new family photography studio in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, founded by two local moms who believe family photography should feel beautiful, natural, and genuinely fun.

We're building something a little different. A modern photography studio with an editorial eye, a playful spirit, and a love for documenting the little moments that make family life special.

We're looking for a creative, social-media-native person to help bring the Daysee world to life online.

**The Role**

We're looking for someone who lives and breathes social media, has an exceptional visual eye, and knows how to create content that feels engaging, authentic, and worth following.

You'll work closely with our founders to help develop and execute our social content, create engaging Reels, curate our Instagram grid, and build relationships with our growing community.

We're particularly interested in someone with a background or strong interest in photography, creative direction, fashion, design, children and family brands, or editorial content.

Our goal is to make our social presence feel less like advertising and more like a visual journal of the people, stories, and moments that make Daysee special.

**What You'll Do**

* **Content Creation:** Create and edit engaging Instagram Reels, Stories, and posts using our professional photography and video content.
* **Grid Planning & Curation:** Help plan and maintain a beautiful, cohesive Instagram grid with a strong editorial aesthetic.
* **Community Engagement:** Build genuine relationships with our followers, local businesses, creators, and relevant NYC communities through thoughtful, proactive engagement.
* **Content Planning:** Help develop and manage a monthly content calendar, ensuring a consistent and thoughtful social presence.
* **Campaign Support:** Support creative planning and content execution for seasonal launches, studio events, collaborations, and promotions.
* **Creative Ideas:** Bring fresh ideas, emerging trends, storytelling concepts, and new content formats that feel relevant to our brand.
* **Performance Insights:** Track basic social performance and help identify what's resonating with our audience.

**Who We're Looking For**

* You're genuinely social-media-native and understand what makes content perform on Instagram and TikTok.
* You have a strong visual eye and appreciation for photography, composition, typography, and editorial design.
* You're confident creating and editing short-form videos, particularly Instagram Reels.
* You're familiar with tools such as CapCut, Canva, Later, Planoly, or similar.
* You understand how to build organic engagement and genuine community connections.
* You're organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently.
* You're a strong communicator who can translate creative direction into polished content.
* You have experience creating content for a brand, creative business, or your own social channels.

**Bonus points if:**

* You have a background in photography, fashion, design, editorial, or another creative field.
* You're based in Brooklyn or NYC.
* You're a photographer or content creator yourself.
* You've helped grow an Instagram account organically.
* You have experience working with lifestyle, family, or hospitality brands.

Working With Us

This is a flexible, part-time role at $30 per hour, averaging approximately 7–8 hours per week.

You'll work closely with our founders on creative direction, with the opportunity to take ownership of social content execution, community engagement, and ongoing content planning.

We'll provide access to our professional photography, video footage, brand assets, and upcoming campaign plans. We're looking for someone who can take these materials and turn them into thoughtful, engaging content, while bringing their own ideas and creative perspective.

As a small, growing business, we value creativity, initiative, collaboration, and people who genuinely care about the work they put into the world.

How to Apply

We'd love to see your work! Please include:

* A short introduction about yourself and why Daysee interests you.
* Examples of Instagram accounts you've worked on or content you've created, especially Reels.
* A portfolio or examples of your creative work, if available.
* One creative idea you'd love to bring to Daysee's Instagram.

We're much more interested in your creative eye, initiative, and understanding of social media than formal qualifications.

**Website:** www.dayseestudio.com  
**Instagram:** @dayseestudio

Pay: From $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 5.0 – 10.0 per week

Application Question(s):

* Please share your social media work you are most proud of (it could be an account, campaign or post that did really well) and explain why it worked. Any extra thoughts on how you would be the right fit for Daysee is also welcome.

As an emerging startup in Buffalo, where New York state fosters rapid and robust growth within the startup community, Circuit Clinical was ranked 20th nationally for Best Workplaces for Innovators by Fast Company® and was named an Inc. Magazine® Best Workplaces 2021. Circuit’s accolades continued beyond the early years as a research industry watchlist company, including winning SCOPE’s Participant Engagement Award in 2022 while continuing to receive national recognition as Fast Company’s World Changing Ideas™ Award 2022. Over the past year, Circuit has remained committed to breaking the norms that have challenged research participation and continues to extend reach within the research industry, having expanded client relationships with multiple pharmaceutical companies and contract research organizations. And we are not done yet. Our growth knows no bounds as we extended our community-based research into the Midwest during 2023 while growing our remote research capabilities across all 50 US states.

Our award-winning culture is grounded in our values, the heart of the Circuit ethos. We focus on building an incredible, hard-charging **Team** and providing them the opportunity to do the best work of their careers. In short, we’re motivated to take on the most challenging problems in developing new medicines – this is work that matters to us and those we serve, the patients.

We must recruit the industry’s most dynamic, mission-driven, empathetic, and passionate leaders to accomplish our mission. That’s where you come in!

**What We Offer**

Suppose you’ve been looking for a chance to work with a unique, highly motivated **Team** and to have a direct impact in building a transformative clinical trials company every day. In that case, that is precisely what we’re offering. We provide competitive benefits and an environment focused on helping you grow personally and professionally.

**What You Will Bring to Our Team**

As our **Research Coordinator** you will be responsible for coordinating, facilitating, and monitoring the implementation of research study protocols being conducted in accordance with departmental policy, institutional policy, sponsor requirements, and FDA regulations. You will also provide, manage, and coordinate care for patients participating in clinical trials in compliance with written study protocols. You will report to the VP, Site Operations and work in collaboration with the Clinical Operations, Regulatory, and Business Development teams.

**Specific responsibilities include:**

* Having thorough knowledge of study protocol, including inclusion and exclusion criteria and confirmation of subject eligibility
* Knowledge of study endpoints, reportable events (Adverse Event, Serious Adverse Event, Adverse Events of Special Interest)
* Knowledge of disease process and standard of care
* Completion of study screen tool and study summary
* Defining methods of subject identification and recruitment
* Thorough knowledge of protocol to conduct Informed Consent Form process
* Completion of screening procedures, randomization, and subject visits
* Investigational Product dispensing and accountability
* Scheduling of study visits in compliance with protocol(s)
* Preparation and maintenance of source documents and IRB submitted documents for recruitment
* Assisting in recruitment efforts, contacting and identifying potentially eligible participants to screen
* Confirming Primary Investigator review of study visits
* Reviewing Adverse Events and Serious Adverse Event with Primary Investigator within 24 hour of event report to Institutional Review Board (IRB) and sponsor
* Subject retention activities and follow up procedures
* Obtaining consents for amendments where applicable
* Participating in protocol amendment training and updates essential documents accordingly
* Sponsoring monitoring activities, preparation, data clarification
* Weekly review of study status
* Obtaining appropriate certification of required trainings
* Contributing to patient recruitment efforts as business demands require.
* Additional duties as assigned.

**Your qualifications include:**

* Licensed as a registered nurse (RN), certified Medical Assistant, or licensed practical nurse (LPN), required
* Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Minimum 1-3 years experience in Clinical Research required
* Reliable transportation is required
* Computer literacy including Microsoft office (Word, Excel), Google suite, and CTMS software a plus.

**What Makes You a Good Candidate**

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**An inclusive work environment is an empowering one. At Cutover, we lead with empathy and enable others to succeed through curiosity, kindness, and self-expression.**

**Location**: This role is flexible in location, but we would expect you to be able to commute to our NYC office on a weekly basis.

**We regret that we are unable to provide sponsorships at this time.**

Cutover provides enterprise technology operations teams with an AI-powered SaaS solution that automates and streamlines complex processes with intelligent runbooks. The Cutover solution enables teams to respond to incidents quickly, recover from IT outages, and manage cloud migrations with precision and efficiency. Cutover is used in many of the world's largest financial institutions to support their critical technology operations, including 5 out of the top 6 largest asset managers and 3 out of the top 5 US banks.

We're excited to grow our Customer Success team with some more energetic and growth-minded Customer Success talent. From initial onboarding to ongoing adoption, our Customer Success Managers assist customers throughout their lifecycle, helping them unlock maximum value from our platform and services. We have a keen focus on driving Monthly Active User ("MAU") growth within our key accounts, as well as focusing on the overall account health by using a data driven approach to unlock value and resolve issues in a proactive manner. Our Customer Success Managers bring energy, creativity and a strong sense of product evangelism to their day-to-day work. We understand our customers' strategy, vision and goals and - as trusted advisors - recommend solutions, enabling them to use the full power of the Cutover platform to bring vision to reality.

This role is ideal for a Customer Success Manager at an early-to-mid career stage who has experience supporting enterprise customers and is looking to deepen their technical, product, and advisory skillset in a fast-growing SaaS environment.

**What we'd like you to bring to the table for this role...**

* 2-4 years of experience in a financial services customer-facing role, ideally in Customer Success.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to manage multiple client projects, identify process gaps, and adapt to technical complexity.
* Technically proficient with modern SaaS tools, a willingness to master the Cutover platform, and innate interest in cloud and AI.
* A balanced approach to customer success, focused on maximizing platform usage and value while collaborating with internal teams to minimize churn and drive growth.
* Strong relationship-building skills across all levels of enterprise organizations, adept at running data-informed business reviews, and a passionate customer advocate.

**The good stuff…**

* We're excited to offer **Share Options** as part of our compensation package.
* **20 days of PTO per year + public holidays**, and we want you to take all of them!
* **3 volunteer days** to use for any charitable/voluntary cause you would like.
* A top-tier private health insurance package.
* 401k contribution plan
* **Work from home stipends**
* A **personal learning and development budget** through Learnerbly. You'll be supported in your quest for knowledge, whatever that looks like to you.
* If you're thinking of starting or growing your family, then you'll be in great company - more than half of our team are parents and we've built a globally consistent parental leave approach that we're proud of.
* Employee Referral Scheme.
* Safeguarding the mental health of our teams is paramount for us. If you'd like to, then you'll be able to avail yourself of **multiple Cutover mental health initiatives**, from fully subsidized therapy sessions to subscriptions to leading wellbeing platforms.

**Target compensation package:** $100,000 - $120,000 base, $25,000 - $30,000 variable + stock options + benefits.

The final offer may vary from the target compensation package, taking into consideration factors such as your experience level and skill set. If we aren't aligned on salary at this stage, we'd still love to hear from you to better understand if there are more suitable opportunities at Cutover.

**Diversity Statement - Empowering Our Teams**

We encourage our team to bring their authentic selves to work, which we have found has strengthened workplace relationships and fostered a genuine sense of community.

*If you are excited by this role, we invite you to apply!* Even if your profile doesn't check all the boxes, please don't simply scroll past! We recognize that talent lies everywhere and that some demographic groups are more likely to apply for a "stretch role" than others. We are always open to different perspectives and professional backgrounds to keep Cutover's culture evolving and to ensure that we never stop learning.

Cutover is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Maintaining an equitable hiring process is imperative to our mission. All applicants are considered without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, mental or physical disability, marital status, protected veteran or parental status.

Learn more about Life at Cutover, our Guiding Principles, and our latest news on Twitter and LinkedIn

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (SMB)
jobs.description:
Vendelux is building the category-defining platform for event marketing intelligence.

Events are one of the largest and most impactful marketing channels, yet historically one of the least measurable. Vendelux brings transparency and performance to this space — helping companies discover, evaluate, and optimize their event strategy with data.

Our platform powers thousands of event decisions by delivering proprietary, AI-driven insights across hundreds of thousands of events globally. At the core of our platform is a robust ecosystem of event organizer partnerships — where organizers share first-party data, enabling richer insights for customers while receiving benchmarking and audience intelligence in return. From identifying the highest ROI conferences to enabling targeted meeting programs, Vendelux helps companies turn events into a predictable and scalable growth engine.

In addition, Vendelux Meetings extends our platform by turning insights into pipeline — using AI to identify high-value attendees and proactively book 1:1 meetings between our customers and their ideal prospects at events. This enables go-to-market teams to drive measurable ROI and maximize every event interaction.

Founded in 2021, Vendelux is a Series B SaaS company backed by top-tier investors including FirstMark. We partner with many of the fastest-growing companies in the world, and our team includes leaders from Bain, ZoomInfo, Shutterstock, FanDuel, Compass, Airbnb, Forter and beyond.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

We're looking for a Customer Success Manager (SMB) who has been in the trenches of a high-growth B2B SaaS company, knows what it takes to manage a complex book of business, and is excited by the opportunity to help shape how we do Customer Success at Vendelux. If you thrive in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment and love the challenge of turning at-risk accounts into long-term champions, we want to talk.

This role is hybrid, 4 days a week in our NYC office.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Function as a true account manager across the full customer lifecycle — from onboarding and enablement through renewals, upsells, and negotiations
* Own a portfolio of accounts simultaneously, managing competing priorities with urgency and precision — expect to juggle 9+ active workstreams at any given time
* Lead structured onboarding and training programs that drive fast time-to-value and long-term product adoption
* Run proactive meeting campaigns and renewal processes, ensuring no account goes dark or falls through the cracks
* Negotiate renewals and expansions with confidence, building strong business cases that demonstrate clear ROI
* **Drive retention with a relentless, creative approach — exhaust every option before accepting churn, whether that's a LinkedIn message, an in-person office visit, a free pilot extension, or bringing in leadership to save the relationship**
* Travel to customer sites a minimum of 2 days per month to strengthen relationships and accelerate outcomes
* Contribute to community building across the customer base through webinars, case studies, and events

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 2+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a hybrid of both — ideally at a B2B SaaS or high-growth tech company
* Proven track record of owning the full client lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, renewals, upsells, and negotiations
* Thrives in a fast-paced environment managing multiple high-priority accounts simultaneously without dropping the ball
* Relentless when it comes to retention — you get creative, you show up, and you don't give up on an account easily
* Comfortable traveling to meet customers in person and building face-to-face relationships
* Highly accountable self-starter who doesn't need to be chased for updates
* Strong communicator who can navigate difficult conversations with customers and internal stakeholders alike

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive base salary and bonus
* Equity
* Healthcare covering medical, dental and vision
* 401(k)
* Catered lunch every day in our NYC office
* Unlimited PTO plus two company-wide shutdowns during the July 4th week and the Christmas – New Year's week

Not all candidates will check all of the requirements listed above and that’s ok! We are open to great people from non-traditional backgrounds.

Vendelux is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

Compensation Range: $120K - $140K

jobs.title: Outside Parts Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Welcome to Allegiance Trucks, where our dedication to service fuels every mile. Since our founding in March 2019, we've been on an unstoppable path of growth, acquiring 17 dealership groups and expanding to over 40 locations across ten states. Our team is as dynamic as it is diverse, united by a shared commitment to prioritize our customers, uplift one another, and foster a workplace where everyone thrives. As a leading truck dealership group, we're proud to represent top-tier brands like International, Hino, Isuzu, and Ford, providing exceptional support to the Northeast's essential trucking community. At Allegiance Trucks, we're not just moving forward - we're driving the future of trucking.
  
  
Why Allegiance Trucks?
  
  
When joining our team, you will be working alongside the best in the business, helping us make Allegiance Trucks great! We are a veteran friendly organization that provides opportunities for additional training, career growth and advancement, as well as a comprehensive benefits package that includes:
  

* Competitive starting pay
* Excellent health benefits including; Medical, Dental and Vision plans, a complimentary life insurance policy, and several other voluntary coverage options to choose from
* Generous Paid Time Off policy, including vacation, sick time and floating holidays
* 401(k) with Company match
* Support and encouragement for your continued advancement with additional training Allegiance Trucks is committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants.

Ready to be directly rewarded for your results? As an Aftermarket Sales Representative, your income reflects your drive. We offer a competitive base salary plus an aggressive incentive plan on eligible gross profit from day one. If you excel at building relationships, expanding existing accounts, and closing new business, you will find a clear path to a six-figure income with Allegiance.
  
  
**Key Duties and Responsibilities:**  

* Implement sales strategies for and sell all Aftermarket products and offerings, to include but not limited to, Parts, Service, Contract Maintenance to achieve revenue growth, market share growth, and gross profit targets.
* Promote and sell “All Makes” and proprietary Parts and Service
* Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive account specific growth strategies for all products and services offered
* Prospect new customers (target 10-15/week) while maintaining current relationships
* Actively listen to discover and find solutions to current and prospective needs
* Create efficient daily customer visit schedule with average target of 12 customers daily
* Utilize network CRM to actively record information about daily customer transactions & interactions, customer sales potential (specific to parts and service) regional actions and events, success & failures, and what sales techniques have proven effective/ineffective.
* Continuously focus on enhancing your skills and capability to better help customers by participating in requisite training programs
* Collaborate with the marketing team to create promotional material and campaigns.
* Stay up on industry trends and competitive offerings.
* Gather and share information from customers and other dealers to help Allegiance to better serve our customers and grow market share.

**What skills do you need to make an impact in this role:**  

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong organizational and time-management abilities.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Proficiency in using CRM software and other sales tools.
* Strong negotiation and closing skills.
* Able to bring on customers new to our network from previous book of business / relationships
* Able to focus on tasks at hand (discipline / execution)
* Able to handle disruptions to daily schedule and routine (agility)
* Able to handle rejection, to be resilient and persistent for the goal at hand
* Strong communication skills with customers, Allegiance employees, and vendors
* Professional attitude, know how to interact with everyone from janitor to dealer principle, whether towards a customer or network
* Professional appearance (Polo, Button Up, Khaki’s, safe shoes)

**Education, Experience, & Licensing Requirements:**  

* High school diploma or equivalent (required).
* Bachelor’s degree in Sales Management, Business, or Marketing (preferred)
* Proven experience in building relationships with and increasing sales to customers’ local/branch level management.
* At least 2 years’ experience in the industry / dealership environment
* At least 2 years' experience doing outside sales.
* Valid state driver's license is required
* Must maintain a clean driving record

As a proud Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE), we do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, religion, sex, sexual stereotyping, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, mental or physical disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, pregnancy (which includes pregnancy, childbirth, and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth, or breastfeeding), or any other protected characteristic. Employment may be contingent upon Allegiance’s receipt of an acceptable and job-related drug test, motor vehicle report, and/or reference check, as applicable and permissible by law.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**First Batch–Digital Marketing Manager**

The First Batch wineries create magic for our guests every day, whether that's bringing a dream wedding to life, creating a delicious new dish to pair with our wine, or helping people discover a new passion on one of our winery tours. We do this with an approachable, warm, inclusive, down-to-earth attitude that reflects our passion for bringing traditional winemaking into urban centers, so people don't have to travel to experience the magic of winemaking.

We are looking for team members who care deeply about creating a friendly, warm experience for our guests and for each other. People who love food, wine and events, and who love to learn, share, and tell others about their stories and adventures.

**Position Summary**

The Digital Marketing Manager is primarily responsible for all digital advertising efforts. This includes not only the programming of paid digital advertising campaigns, but tracking their efficacy, analyzing data, preparing reports, building and optimizing landing pages, and ensuring website content is created and optimized to convert leads.

**Core Responsibilities**

Digital Advertising:

* Paid ad creation & management on platforms including but not limited to Google, Meta, Reddit, Bing.
* Collaborate with Creative Marketing Manager to ensure content and content deployment on organic channels aligns & supports paid strategies and to utilize any high performing organic content.
* Conduct paid search governance by conducting daily, weekly, and monthly audits of paid ads infrastructure, ensuring flawless tracking, clean campaign hierarchy, and optimal budget allocation.
* Mitigate against wasted spend by actively managing search term reports to identify, build, and maintain robust negative keyword lists, routinely reducing cost-per-acquisition (CPA).
* Optimize creative assets via routine audits and A/B testing ad creatives, copy variants, and asset extensions (sitelinks, images, promotions) to maximize click through rate, lead conversion, and quality scores.
* Monitor and guide Google’s smart bidding and performance max algorithms by auditing conversion signals, audience inputs, and target KPIs regularly.
* Ownership of all SEO & GEO efforts including ranking and citations.
* Responsible for tracking all platform changes including core updates, new features, and testing any new AI/Agentic tools.

Data, Analytics, and Strategic Forecasting:

* Maintain ongoing, deep analysis of campaign data; have a "finger on the pulse" of the advertising engine at all times to instantly catch anomalies or scale wins.
* Own the weekly update of the results dashboard (Google Sheets) and synthesize complex data into clear, actionable quarterly performance reports for the executive team.
* Champion data hygiene by routinely auditing conversion tracking, UTM tagging, and GA4 integration to ensure 100% accurate attribution.
* Translate raw metrics into a cohesive strategic approach for paid advertising, ensuring daily and weekly optimization tactics align with high- level business goals.
* Analyze historical performance data and market trends to feed into the annual marketing plan, establishing realistic KPIs and tactical roadmaps to hit company growth objectives.
* Formulate and execute a continuous A/B testing framework (for creative, copy, and landing pages), using performance data to foster a culture of constant optimization.

Website Landing Page & UX Optimization:

* Ensure Ad-to-Page alignment. Design, launch, and manage high-converting landing pages specifically tailored to paid ad campaigns, ensuring an intuitive user experience (UX) from click to conversion.
* Maximize quality score & ad rank by building landing pages optimized for Google’s core ranking factors—maximizing Relevance, Expected Click-Through Rate, and Landing Page Experience to lower Cost-Per-Click (CPC) and boost Ad Rank.
* Boost AI & Search Engine Readability. Partner with our web developers to structure website content, technical metadata, and on-page schema so it is effortlessly crawled, understood, and surfaced by Google’s AI search models and algorithms.
* Improve conversion rate optimization through running continuous A/B and multivariate tests on landing pages (testing headlines, layouts, form lengths, and CTAs) to systematically improve conversion rates.
* Monitor core web vitals & technical health by collaborating with our web developers to ensure landing pages load instantly, feature seamless mobile responsiveness, and meet Google’s stringent page-speed performance benchmarks.
* Ensure all new landing pages and web assets are properly instrumented with Google Tag Manager, heatmaps, and event-tracking pixels before launching campaigns.
* Create website content that meets EEAT standards & converts website visitors into leads.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in paid digital advertising across platforms like Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Meta, and Reddit.
* Google Analytics and Google Ads certified
* High software literacy - the ability to quickly learn and adapt to new/different software systems such as website CMS, CRMs, Project Management software, AI tools, etc.
* Experience supporting a multi-faceted business model that includes multiple verticals
* Wine and hospitality experience desired but not required
* Experience working in Google Suite, especially Drive, Sheets and Docs
* Proficient in Excel
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to present information clearly and concisely
* Accurate and consistent work with exceptional attention to detail
* Self-starter attitude, willingness and eagerness to learn
* Ability to confidently work autonomously and with varying levels of adaptability amidst changing priorities

**Essential Duties**

* Ability to travel amongst our three locations
* Must be able to lift up to 30 pounds
* Must be on property 1-2 days a week
* Frequent walking, standing, or moving between departments or

StratosMark, Inc. is looking for motivated, outgoing individuals to join our Brooklyn team as a Sales Representative. This is a customer-facing opportunity for people who enjoy talking with others, learning about technology, and helping customers find wireless solutions that fit their needs.

As a Sales Representative, you’ll represent AT&T in a retail environment, speak with customers about smartphones and wireless services, answer questions, and help customers choose products and plans. You’ll receive hands-on training and support while building valuable sales, communication, and customer service skills.

**No previous wireless sales experience is required.** Experience in retail, hospitality, customer service, restaurants, or other people-focused roles is a plus.

**What You’ll Do as a Sales Representative**

* Welcome customers and create a positive, professional experience.
* Represent AT&T by introducing customers to smartphones, wireless services, promotions, and available upgrades.
* Ask questions to understand customer needs and recommend appropriate AT&T products and services.
* Demonstrate smartphones, wireless features, and available promotions in a clear and easy-to-understand way.
* Help customers with upgrades, new lines, transfers, and other account needs.
* Explain current offers, device options, and wireless plans to help customers make informed decisions.
* Build strong customer relationships while working toward individual and team sales goals.
* Keep customer information and sales records accurate.
* Work with your team to create a welcoming and productive retail environment.
* Develop your communication, customer service, and sales skills as a Sales Representative.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
* Strong communication and people skills.
* Comfortable speaking with customers face-to-face.
* Motivated, dependable, and team-oriented.
* Interest in technology, smartphones, or wireless services.
* Basic computer skills and ability to learn new systems.
* Retail, sales, hospitality, restaurant, or customer service experience is a plus, but **not required**.
* **Entry-level candidates are encouraged to apply.**

**Why Join StratosMark, Inc.?**

* Entry-level Sales Representative opportunity.
* Hands-on training and ongoing support.
* Learn valuable sales and customer service skills.
* Opportunities to **grow within the company and take on greater responsibilities**.
* Professional development and career growth opportunities.
* Work in a fast-paced, customer-focused retail environment.
* Gain valuable experience representing a recognized wireless brand.

If you enjoy working with people, learning new skills, and building your career in sales, apply today for the **Sales Representative** position in Brooklyn.

Benefits:

* Employee discount
