jobs.title: Hotel Partnerships & Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
About the job

Hotel Partnerships & Business Development Representative

**Bagzee | Remote | Commission Only | Flexible / Part-Time**

Company Description

Bagzee is redefining travel convenience through its proprietary platform for on-demand luggage pickup, storage, and direct delivery to hotels, airports, and other destinations.

Unlike traditional luggage storage services, Bagzee eliminates the need for travelers to return to hotels or third-party storage locations to retrieve their belongings. Instead, we handle the luggage logistics, allowing travelers to enjoy their time without being tied to their bags.

With real-time tracking, secure handling procedures, and an established operational network, Bagzee is already serving customers across **New York City and Orlando**, with plans to expand into additional markets.

Role Description

We're looking for a motivated **Hotel Partnerships & Business Development Representative** to help Bagzee expand its network of hotel partners, hotel groups, vacation rental operators, and hospitality professionals.

This is a **commission-only opportunity** designed for someone who is comfortable with outbound sales, relationship building, and independently developing partnerships.

The role offers complete flexibility, making it particularly attractive to hospitality professionals, independent consultants, or individuals with established industry networks looking to generate additional income.

Why Bagzee?

**You're not selling another software subscription or generic hotel service.**

**You're helping hotels offer their guests something they actually experience and value: the freedom to travel without their luggage.**

**Bagzee provides hotels with an additional guest amenity and revenue opportunity that requires no upfront investment, additional staffing, or changes to existing operations**. This makes it a straightforward, low-commitment partnership for hotels to adopt.

Bagzee is already operational, has active customers and hotel partnerships, and is expanding into additional airports and markets.

This is an opportunity to get involved early and have a direct impact on the growth of a travel company building a new category of infrastructure.

Who We're Looking For

We're particularly interested in individuals with experience or existing relationships in the hospitality industry, including:

* Hotel sales, business development, or strategic partnerships.
* Hotel management, operations, or ownership groups.
* Hospitality consulting or independent sales.
* Established relationships with hotel general managers, executives, or hospitality decision-makers.

**Existing hospitality industry connections are a strong advantage**, but we're equally open to motivated business development professionals who can independently identify opportunities and establish new relationships.

Compensation & Flexibility

**Commission only —**

**Earn commissions on revenue generated from hotel partnerships that you directly source and help close.**

**Unlike traditional one-time sales commissions, Bagzee offers the opportunity to earn recurring commissions on bookings generated through the hotel partnerships you establish**, with **significant earnings potential**.

This means a single successful partnership can continue generating commission income as guests book through that hotel, rather than requiring a new sale for every payout.

**Uncapped earning potential. Fully remote. No fixed schedules or minimum hourly requirements.**

**This opportunity is ideal for independent sales professionals, hospitality consultants, or well-connected individuals looking to leverage their existing relationships while maintaining complete flexibility.**

Pay: $40,000.00 - $125,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Do you have existing connections in the hotel or hospitality industry in NYC ?

Experience:

* Hospitality: 2 years (Preferred)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10041

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
==============

DoubleVerify is a leading software platform for digital media measurement, data and analytics. DV’s mission is to be the definitive source of transparency and data-driven insights into the quality and effectiveness of digital advertising for the world’s largest brands, publishers and digital ad platforms. DV’s technology platform provides advertisers with consistent and unbiased data and analytics that can be used to optimize the quality and return on their digital ad investments. Since 2008, DV has helped hundreds of Fortune 500 companies gain the most from their media spend by delivering best in class solutions across the digital advertising ecosystem, helping to build a better industry. Learn more at www.doubleverify.com.

DoubleVerify is adding a Sales Development Representative to the Commercial team to accelerate account growth and pipeline generation across the business. This role sits at the intersection of Sales and Marketing and carries three responsibilities: expanding existing agency and brand-direct relationships, building qualified pipelines for the Growth & Ignition Mid-Market, New Business, Performance, and Strategic Accounts sales teams, and converting inbound interest into closed revenue on smaller services deals.

**What You'll Do**
==================

You will work daily with Client Partners and Enterprise Sales Directors across DoubleVerify's sales teams, and partner closely with Marketing to turn signals into meetings and meetings into opportunities. This is a highly visible, cross-functional role for someone who wants exposure to the full breadth of DV's commercial organization while building toward a closing sales seat.

**Expand accounts and open new doors**
--------------------------------------

  

* Map stakeholders beyond the current point of contact inside existing agency (holding company and independent) and brand-direct accounts
* Identify and open conversations with new buying centers and teams inside current client organizations to widen DoubleVerify's footprint
* Partner with Client Partners to surface upsell and cross-sell opportunities where clients are not yet using the full DV platform

**Build pipeline across sales teams**
-------------------------------------

  

* Generate qualified opportunities for the G&I Mid-Market, New Business, Performance, and Strategic Accounts sales teams through multi-channel outbound: email, calls, LinkedIn, and other prospecting channels
* Research target accounts, identify decision-makers, and personalize outreach using DoubleVerify's sales and AI tools
* Partner with Marketing on lead follow-up, campaign execution, and event outreach
* Keep prospecting activity, qualification notes, and opportunity status current in Salesforce

**Qualify inbound leads and close smaller deals**
-------------------------------------------------

  

* Respond to and qualify inbound leads generated by Marketing, and route strategic opportunities to the appropriate Enterprise Sales Director
* Own and close smaller services deals directly, from qualification through signature
* Run discovery calls to confirm fit and need before handoff or close
* Track qualification criteria, conversion rates, and inbound funnel performance, and report results to Sales leadership

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

  

* 1 to 3 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, or lead generation, ideally in digital media, ad tech, or SaaS
* A track record of meeting or exceeding pipeline, qualification, or quota targets
* Comfort with heavy outbound activity, including cold calling, email prospecting, and social selling
* Working knowledge of a modern sales stack (Salesforce or a comparable CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, sales engagement tools) and familiarity with AI tools for research and personalization
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain DoubleVerify's value proposition clearly to media and marketing buyers
* A process-oriented, data-driven approach to prospecting and account planning
* A collaborative mindset and the ambition to grow into a closing sales role at DoubleVerify
* Based in or willing to work from New York, NY

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on a number of non-discriminating factors, including qualifications for the role, level, skills, experience, location, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at DV. The estimated salary range for this role based on the qualifications set forth in the job description is between $69,000 to $101,000. This role will also be eligible for bonus/commission (as applicable), equity, and benefits. The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description; however, we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be more or less experienced than this job description as posted.

Not-so-fun fact: Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of job criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you have what it takes but you’re not sure that you check every box, apply anyway!

**About WundaBar**

At Wundabar, we’re on a mission to change lives through the power of movement. Our revolutionary Pilates equipment and unique class offerings create a dynamic experience that transforms clients both physically and mentally. Join our passionate team and help bring the WundaBar experience to new and existing clients.

**Position Overview**

As a **Sales Representative** at WundaBar, you will play a key role in driving sales and supporting our studio operations. This position is ideal for someone with a passion for health and fitness, who enjoys building relationships with clients and helping them discover the benefits of Pilates. You will be the first point of contact for prospective clients, guiding them through our class offerings, memberships, and retail products.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Client Engagement**: Welcome potential and existing clients to the studio, answering inquiries about WundaBar Pilates classes, membership packages, and retail products.
* **Sales**: Drive membership sales and upsell class packages, private sessions, and retail items. Meet and exceed sales targets while maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction.
* **Consultations**: Conduct studio tours, provide in-depth explanations of the WundaBar Pilates method, and match clients with the right services based on their goals and needs.
* **Customer Relationship Management**: Build lasting relationships with clients, ensuring they feel valued and supported throughout their fitness journey.
* **Client Onboarding**: Facilitate the onboarding process for new clients, including class sign-ups, membership registration, and ensuring a smooth start to their WundaBar experience.
* **Administrative Support**: Assist with studio operations, including scheduling, answering calls, managing email inquiries, and processing sales transactions through our POS system.
* **Promotion of Events and Offers**: Actively promote studio events, workshops, special offers, and retail products to enhance the client experience and boost sales.
* Other projects and responsibilities may be added at the owner’s discretion, including administrative duties

**Qualifications**

* **Experience**: 1-2 years of sales experience, preferably in a fitness or wellness environment.
* **Customer Service**: Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a customer-first mindset.
* **Fitness Passion**: A genuine interest in Pilates and fitness, and the ability to educate others on the benefits of Pilates.
* **Sales Skills**: Ability to meet sales targets and overcome objections while maintaining a consultative, solution-based approach.
* **Tech Savvy**: Comfortable using studio management software, point-of-sale systems, and other digital tools.
* **Team Player**: Ability to work collaboratively with the studio team, contributing to a positive and supportive environment.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to stand, walk, and interact with clients for extended periods.
* Comfortable with light physical activity related to assisting clients and setting up equipment when necessary.

**Perks & Benefits**

* $18/hr + commission
* Free and discounted Pilates classes
* Health & wellness benefits
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A fun and supportive work environment!

Benefits:

* Opportunities for advancement

jobs.description:
**Location:** This is a hybrid remote/in-office role. Medidata follows a hybrid office policy in which employees who are hired for an in-person position are expected to work on site a certain number of days per week following Company policy.
  
About our Company

  

Medidata is powering smarter treatments and healthier people through digital solutions to support clinical trials. Celebrating over 25 years of ground-breaking technological innovation across more than 38,000 trials and 12 million patients, Medidata offers industry-leading expertise, analytics-powered insights, and one of the largest clinical trial data sets in the industry. More than 1 million registered users across approximately 2,300 customers trust Medidata's seamless, end-to-end platform to improve patient experiences, accelerate clinical breakthroughs, and bring therapies to market faster. A Dassault Systèmes brand (Euronext Paris: FR0014003TT8, DSY.PA), Medidata is headquartered in New York City and has been recognized as a Leader by Everest Group and IDC. Discover more at www.medidata.com. Listen to our latest podcast, From Dreamers to Disruptors, and follow us at @Medidata.

About the Team

  

Join the North American Business Development Team, part of the Medidata Solutions NAM Sales Team, responsible for promoting the Medidata portfolio directly to our customers. Reporting to the Business Development Manager, you will serve as the first line of engagement for incoming interest, helping identify, qualify, and develop prospective customers or unexplored markets in a focused portfolio set. Working in close collaboration with Demand Marketing, Account Executives, and Product Specialist teams, you will qualify marketing-generated pipeline and convert inbound demand into viable sales opportunities to drive business growth for Medidata Solutions.

**Responsibilities**:

* Respond promptly to inbound inquiries, website leads, trial requests, and marketing-generated prospects across phone, email, and digital channels.
* Qualify inbound marketing-generated pipeline through discovery, researching prospect business models and identifying their core clinical research challenges.
* Complete weekly activities to meet established sales performance metrics, pipeline goals, and conversion targets.
* Generate and qualify opportunities with the direct support of technical and product specialists.
* Coordinate smooth, qualified opportunity handoffs and briefing notes from the Business Development team to assigned Account Managers and Account Executives.
* Maintain clean records of inbound interactions, qualification notes, and prospect data within Salesforce and Outreach to ensure accurate reporting and forecasting.
* Follow up on leads generated from company-sponsored events, webinars, conferences, and targeted marketing campaigns to maximize ROI and brand engagement.
* Facilitate initial administrative steps, including routing Medidata NDA agreements through internal teams and prospect legal counsel.
* Build expertise within your assigned portfolio and actively participate in professional development activities to stay current on life sciences and SaaS trends.
* Approach your territory with an ownership mindset, using client engagements and discovery conversations to match customer pain points with tailored Medidata solutions.

**Qualifications:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or a related field required.
* **Industry Acumen:** Working knowledge of the clinical development, clinical trials, or laboratory environment.
* **Experience:** Proven business development or sales experience with a track record of meeting or exceeding performance metrics and quotas.
* **Software Experience:** Background in SaaS sales, with hands-on proficiency using CRM and sales engagement tools such as Salesforce and Outreach.
* **Communication Skills:** Confident, articulate communicator across multi-channel outreach (phone, email, video conferencing) with strong active listening and discovery skills.
* **Mindset:** Collaborative team player, highly motivated to manage inbound volume, prioritize effectively, and exceed individual and team goals.

The salary range posted below refers only to positions that will be physically based in New York City. As with all roles, Medidata sets ranges based on a number of factors including function, level, candidate expertise and experience, and geographic location. Pay ranges for candidates in locations other than New York City, may differ based on the local market data in that region. The base salary pay range for this position is $58,500 to $66,000.

Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Medidata provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Most sales positions are eligible for a commission on the terms of applicable plan documents, and many of Medidata's non-sales positions are eligible for annual bonuses. Medidata believes that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most and provides best-in-class benefits, including medical, dental, life and disability insurance; 401(k) matching; flexible paid time off; and 10 paid holidays per year.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Penguin Random House is the leading adult and children's publishing house in North America, the United Kingdom and many other regions around the world. In publishing the best books in every genre and subject for all ages, we are committed to quality, excellence in execution, and innovation throughout the entire publishing process: editorial, design, marketing, publicity, sales, production, and distribution. Our vibrant and diverse international community of nearly 300 publishing brands and imprints include Ballantine Bantam Dell, Berkley, Clarkson Potter, Crown, DK, Doubleday, Dutton, Grosset & Dunlap, Little Golden Books, Knopf, Modern Library, Pantheon, Penguin Books, Penguin Press, Penguin Random House Audio, Penguin Young Readers, Portfolio, Puffin, Putnam, Random House, Random House Children's Books, Riverhead, Ten Speed Press, Viking, and Vintage, among others. More information can be found at http://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/.

 **Job Description**

Random House Children’s Books, a division of Penguin Random House, seeks a hands-on and detail-oriented Marketing Assistant who will be an essential member of the Licensed & Proprietary Brands Marketing team. The Marketing Assistant will assist and manage daily administrative and marketing tasks and act as a liaison between third-party partners and within our internal departments at Random House Children’s Books and Penguin Random House.

This position offers a unique perspective on the strategy and operations of Random House Children’s Books, home to beloved, classic children’s book authors and brands like Dr. Seuss, Magic Tree House, Richard Scarry, and Little Golden Books, as well as current licenses like Disney, Ms. Rachel, Sesame Street, and Netflix. Creating books for toddlers through young adult readers, the imprints of Random House Children’s Books bring together award-winning authors and illustrators, world-famous franchise characters, and multimillion-copy series.

As the Marketing Assistant, you will be part of a fun and fast-paced group, focusing on our in-house brands. Reporting to the Senior Director, you'll meet and work closely with many colleagues across our internal departments at Random House Children’s Books and Penguin Random House. The role is ideal for someone who has an interest in working with brand marketing and is a solutions-focused creative thinker with the ability to handle multiple tasks at one time in a deadline-driven environment.

This hybrid position, requiring someone to be in office 2-3 times each week. The role has occasional in-office responsibilities, including but not limited to in-office meetings, author visits or events, and daily ad hoc administrative projects. We will consider candidates who can work from a commutable distance to our offices at 1745 Broadway, which includes the tri-state area (NJ, CT, & PA). The salary for this position is $55,000.

**ABOUT US**

Established in 1988, the Cumberland Community Improvement District (CCID) is Georgia’s first Community Improvement District. Comprised of approximately 190 commercial property owners who contribute additional property taxes within the Cumberland area of Northwest Atlanta, the CCID reinvests these funds in infrastructure, transportation, placemaking, and public realm improvements that enhance the value and quality of life for businesses, property owners, residents, and visitors.

**OUR BENEFITS**

The CCID offers a competitive benefits package, including a 401(a)/457(b) retirement plan, medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, and a flexible spending account (FSA). We provide more than 20 days of PTO annually, 15 paid holidays, and parental leave.

The Cumberland Community Improvement District is seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Planning and Project Coordinator to support public realm maintenance and enhancements, infrastructure delivery, and community development initiatives throughout the Cumberland district.

jobs.title: Onsite Client Success Associate
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**  
Our story began in 2011 when a group of office workers at a major logistics company in Chicago had a lunch problem. Nearby options were limited, and the team was spending too much time and money traveling to their favorite restaurants. They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something.  
  
Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities with over 100 million meals served and continue to grow rapidly.  
  
Powered by technology and a network of 3,500+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. At Fooda, we believe a workplace food program should be something employees love and look forward to every day.

**Position Overview:**  
As a Client Success Associate you will play a key role in managing day-to-day operations for Atlanta, GA. Your “North Star” is delivering a consistently exceptional lunch experience for our clients and their employees.  
  
You will work closely with the Senior Manger of Client Success and serve as the primary point of contact for clients, oversee on-site staff, and support the launch of new locations. This role requires 40% local travel within the Atlanta Market, along with weekly office attendance.  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Assist in managing daily Popup operations of the Atlanta, GA market.
* Serve as the client-facing point of contact, including day-of support and communication, recurring meetings, and Business Reviews.
* Lead the successful launch of new accounts, including coordinating with client contacts, conducting on-site walk-throughs, and managing internal systems setup and on-site implementation.
* Regularly visit client locations to audit restaurants, gather feedback from customers, and build strong relationships with clients.
* Coordinate site evaluations and inspections with health department.
* Collaborate closely with your team to deliver a consistently excellent service experience that meets and exceeds client expectations.

  
**Requirements**

**Who You Are:**

* 2+ years of work experience focused on client-success, account management, hospitality, and/or food service.
* You love process, work fast, and care about the details
* You are savvy with technology and will be comfortable in a fast-paced environment.
* You are optimistic in the face of problems and know that you’re capable of finding solutions.
* You’re hands-on and love getting into the weeds.
* You can lift and carry up to 40 lbs. and stand for up to two hours.
* You have strong communication skills and are comfortable giving direction.
* Experience managing part-time or full-time staff preferred but not required.

  
**Benefits**

**What We’ll Hook You Up With:**

* Competitive market salary and stock options, based on experience
* Comprehensive health, dental and vision plans
* 401k retirement plan with company match
* Paid maternity and parental leave benefits
* Flexible spending accounts
* Monthly cell phone stipend
* Company-issued laptop
* Regular menu taste-tests from new restaurant partners.
* A fulfilling, challenging adventure of a work experience

**Must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. No recruiters please.**

As we establish our brand-new, state-of-the-art production facility in the United States, you will be a versatile and detail-oriented Administrative & Operations Coordinator, supporting the Head of Operations as one of the first foundational team members on the ground. In this cross-functional role, you will bridge Finance, People & Culture, and Office Operations by coordinating local administrative workflows, vendor invoicing, basic bookkeeping support, and recruitment administration. * 2–4+ years of hands-on experience in administrative support, office coordination, bookkeeping, HR operations, or a comparable operational role.

* Experience with accounts payable, invoice processing, purchase order tracking, or basic accounting principles.

jobs.description:
**Who we are:**

Formic is on a mission to reshape American manufacturing by making automation accessible to every factory. As labor constraints rise, costs increase, and global competition intensifies, automation is no longer optional for manufacturers that want to stay competitive.

We deliver automation through a Robotics-as-a-Service model that combines industrial robotics, proprietary software, and full-service support into a single, integrated solution. By removing the traditional barriers of cost, complexity, and risk, we enable manufacturers to deploy automation quickly and realize measurable gains in throughput, safety, and operational efficiency without large upfront capital investment.

Backed by leading investors including Lux Capital, Initialized Capital, Blackhorn Ventures, and Mitsubishi HC Capital North America, Formic is scaling rapidly and building the foundation for a new era of high-performance, Made in America production.

**About the Customer Success team:**

Customer Success is dedicated to enabling our customers to get the most out of the automation we deploy, facilitating a superb experience through all facets of our relationship. We are manufacturing and automation experts–consulting with customers to drive adoption and optimal usage of our robotic automation solutions, and identifying opportunities to continue their automation journey.

As *Customer Success Manager*, you will serve as the primary point of contact and advisory partner for our customers: visiting and consulting with those customers in the field, and driving solutions across various groups within Formic for optimal delivery of technical, operational, training and administrative support for our industrial robot systems.

You will play a key role in driving mutually beneficial customer relationships post-deployment by monitoring customer health and engagement, mitigating potential relationship and experience risks, and identifying growth opportunities in existing accounts. You will build and maintain strong customer relationships; develop a deep understanding of their business goals, challenges, and needs; and will leverage that feedback to provide customized insights and value-added products and services. This position is highly strategic and impactful in Formic's mission to be a valued partner and leader driving the adoption of automation across the manufacturing industry.

Internally, you will act as the voice of the customer within Formic, delivering feedback and recommendations internally to drive product and process improvements to yield better outcomes and experience. You will be instrumental in equipping Formic's various teams to consistently deliver high performance automation solutions with superb customer experience.

**As Customer Success Manager, you will:**

* Serve as the primary consultative partner and point of contact for the group of customers you are responsible for: building strong relationships; facilitating technical, operational, training, and administrative support; and identifying opportunities for expansion.
* Oversee a regular cadence of communication and site visits (including regular travel throughout your region) to assess satisfaction with deployed robotic automation systems, address relationship issues, facilitate and offer training, solicit feedback, and identify opportunities for growth and improvement.
* Monitor & manage health and engagement by using diagnostic tools and strategic communication, identifying and mitigating potential relationship and experience risks.
* Collaborate with Formic's Sales, Deployment, and Service teams to guide customers - particularly first time automation buyers - through their automation journey.
* Identify opportunities for growth of products and services within existing accounts, including deployment of additional like-for-like solutions, or upstream or downstream standard solutions.
* Leverage understanding of customers' businesses to provide feedback for new product offerings and service enhancements for Formic to better serve their needs.

**What makes you a great fit:**

* 3-5+ years of experience in a manufacturing operations role (e.g. Plant or Production Manager/Supervisor/Process Engineering Leader) in a manufacturing or production operations environment.
* Familiarity with robotic automation systems in a manufacturing or production environment (e.g. robotic automation of palletizing, de-palletizing, case packing, machine tending, welding, injection molding).
* Outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills–able to build trusting relationships with diverse stakeholders and audiences and collaborate cross-functionally
* Strong judgment and calm execution during escalations, shifting priorities, and time-sensitive customer needs
* Ability to identify expansion opportunities through strong relationships, customer insight, and operational outcomes
* Proficiency with CRM and customer relationship management tools such as Salesforce, ticketing systems, or project tracking platforms
* Strong operational discipline, follow-through, and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
* + Experience working with industrial, manufacturing, hardware, robotics, or operationally complex customers preferred
* Experience working successfully with a portfolio of industrial automation users leading to adoption, expansion and renewals preferred–ideally of technical platforms and solutions
* Consultative sales experience is a plus
* Ability to travel ~30% of the time to customer sites across their region, living in close proximity to a major airport
* Holding a current, valid driver's license and access to a vehicle

**What we look for:**

We're building this company from the ground up, and every person we hire has an outsized impact on our culture, performance, and trajectory. While each team member brings unique strengths and perspectives, we look for people who align with our Operating Principles and embody them in action

Endeavor is real-world enterprise AI.

AI models are improving faster than most companies can put them to work. Endeavor closes that gap.

We exist to secure American industrial leadership. AI is the largest advantage available to the companies that make, move, and defend things in this country, and most of them can't reach it alone. jobs.title: Assistant Community Manager
jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Assistant Community Manager plays a critical operational and compliance leadership role, supporting the Community Manager in the administrative, financial, and physical management of the property. Serving as an intentional career pathway toward property leadership, this position holds primary accountability for recertification management and regulatory compliance while actively assisting with daily office operations, rent collection, leasing, and resident relations. The Assistant Community Manager ensures the property operates efficiently, meets all contractual and affordable housing guidelines, and upholds high standards of customer service and mission-driven housing stability.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Compliance and Recertification [40%]**

* Own the resident recertification caseload, ensuring all annual and interim recertifications, gross rent changes, and unit transfers are completed accurately and within mandatory timeframes.
* Conduct applicant and participant interviews, gather third-party verifications, complete calculations, and prepare thorough, audit-ready compliance packages.
* Maintain compliance across all financing layers, including Section 42 (LIHTC), HUD, HOME, PBRA, Bonds, FHLB, and Section 811.
* Maintain electronic and physical resident files in strict adherence to data security, Fair Housing, ADA, and auditing standards.
* Coordinate directly with state housing finance agencies, compliance auditors, and third-party monitoring groups.

**Site Administration [30%]**

* Support the Community Manager with daily administrative workflows, serving as the acting manager in their absence.
* Assist with rent collections, daily bank deposits, ledger adjustments, and delinquent account follow-ups in accordance with local tenant laws.
* Draft and distribute general notices, lease violation notices, and legal documentation utilizing eviction-prevention and de-escalation strategies.
* Assist the Community Manager with accounts payable, invoice processing, and variance tracking.
* Maintain office organization, logs, reports, and administrative supply inventories.

**Resident Relations [15%]**

* Serve as an escalation point for resident disputes, lease violations, and complex inquiries routed from the front desk.
* Educate residents on lease terms, program obligations, and recertification deadlines.
* Partner collaboratively with on-site service providers to process reasonable accommodations and support resident retention.

**Leasing and Maintenance [15%]**

* Process housing applications, maintain the property waitlist, verify eligibility, and execute initial lease signings.
* Monitor the Yardi service request dashboard to track ticket aging, conduct QA on completed tickets, and manage the administrative workflow for unit turns alongside the maintenance team.
* Assist with move-in/move-out inspections, annual unit inspections, and monitoring unit turnover readiness.

**REQUIRED SKILLS AND ABILITIES**

* Deep knowledge of affordable housing policies, HUD guidelines, and LIHTC compliance procedures.
* Proficiency in Yardi Voyager (or equivalent property management software) and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).
* Strong organizational, mathematical, and analytical skills with rigorous attention to detail.
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with proven de-escalation ability.
* Ability to handle multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced environment.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* 2+ years of affordable housing property management experience, with direct experience processing recertifications.
* Valid driver’s license, auto insurance, and reliable transportation.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Tax Credit Certification (e.g., TCS, COS, HCCP, or BOS) or required within 120 days of hire.
* Prior experience with Permanent Supportive Housing (PSH) and vulnerable populations.
* Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Real Estate, or related field.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

* Occasionally requires moving materials weighing up to 20 lbs.
* Unit and property inspections require walking, stair climbing, and general facility navigation.

**LOCATION AND TRAVEL**

* Based on-site at 5150 N. Northwest Highway, Chicago, IL 60630
* Schedule: Full-Time; non-exempt; Monday–Friday, plus weekends/holidays as needed
* Requires occasional travel for regional meetings, trainings, or emergent support at neighboring portfolio properties.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

Salary: $24.00 - $28.00/hour, commensurate with experience

We believe in supporting the people who support our residents. Our benefits include:

* 11 days of paid vacation
* 12 paid company holidays
* 3 floating holidays
* Employer-supported medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Paid parental leave
* SIMPLE IRA with up to a 3% employer match
* Employee Assistance Program
* Up to $5,250 annually for professional development and education assistance
* Opportunities for career growth within a mission-driven organization

**REVIEW CYCLE**

This job description is subject to a mandatory review every 24 months. Next scheduled review: December 2026.

Pay: $24.00 - $28.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

**CURATE GROUP**

**Role:** Event Operations Manager, Lumos Experiences

**Reports to**: Head of Regional Events, Los Angeles

**Contract Type**: Full time 3:2

**Office Location:** Los Angeles area

**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

Curate Group is a dynamic events and experiences company, creating unforgettable moments that bring people together. We specialize in unique, high-quality live events - from large scale festivals, immersive concerts, cultural experiences and corporate events partnering with some of the world’s most exciting brands.

One of our core event brands, Lumos Experiences, is one of the most distinctive live entertainment concepts, creating atmospheric candlelit concerts that transform unexpected spaces into something genuinely magical. We're growing fast, running multiple shows per week across new cities and countries and we're looking for a highly organized **Event Operations Manager** to support the ongoing running of our shows.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

Lumos is scaling rapidly across Los Angeles and we're looking for an experienced **Event Operations Manager** to lead the successful delivery of our live events. You'll own operational planning and execution across multiple venues, ensuring every show runs smoothly, safely and consistently while supporting the continued growth of the business.

This role suits someone who takes real pride in their work and spots what needs doing before being asked. You'll be a proactive problem-solver who thrives on responsibility, makes confident decisions and brings both energy and precision to everything you do. This isn't a role for someone who waits to be directed, it's for someone who leads, cares and makes things happen.

You'll also spend time at some of the shows because the best operations leaders stay close to the experience they're delivering. Seeing your events firsthand allows you to coach teams, identify improvements and continually raise standards across the region.

**SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE**

Success in this role will be measured through event quality, operational consistency, staffing performance, wise budget management, positive guest feedback and the ability to support the region's continued growth.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **End-to-End Event Operations:** Own the full operational delivery of our shows across Los Angeles and surrounding regions, from pre-show planning and venue coordination to on-the-ground execution and post-event review, ensuring every event runs smoothly, on-brand and to a high standard.
* **Venue Management:** Maintain a detailed venue catalogue with layouts, access and contact information. Liaise with venues to develop event operations plans, venue advance sheets, emergency procedures and safety documentation as required.
* **Staff Recruitment, Scheduling & Training:** Lead weekend team recruitment, onboarding and ongoing training for Event Managers and Assistants. Manage and maintain up-to-date training resources, playbooks and manager toolkits.
* **Musician &** **Production Coordination:** Work with the Musician Booker to ensure artists are well-briefed and supported. Oversee production teams to ensure all technical and operational elements are executed seamlessly.
* **Processes & Operational Standards:** Develop and standardize processes across all shows to drive consistency, reduce ambiguity and improve efficiency.
* **Budget & Inventory Management:** Manage inventory, storage locations, equipment maintenance and logistics to ensure events are properly resourced.
* **Field Presence & Quality Control:** Attend a minimum of two shows per month, with additional event attendance as needed during training, launches and peak periods (shows are Fridays and Saturdays).
* **Reporting & Continuous Improvement:** Deliver post-event reports, analyze KPIs and customer feedback and proactively propose improvements to keep Lumos ahead of industry trends.
* **Special Event & Venue Preparation:** Coordinate venue-specific requirements including permits, vendor sourcing, local compliance requirements, and operational planning for unique or non-traditional event spaces.
* **Coordinate Venue Insurance Requirements:** certificates of insurance (COIs), vendor documentation, permits and compliance records to ensure all events meet venue and local requirements.

**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* Proven experience in event operations, production or management. Ideally within the live entertainment or hospitality sectors.
* A natural self-starter who thrives on responsibility and momentum.
* Ability to motivate a team, set and uphold high standards and bring energy to your events.
* Confident in making decisions, even under pressure and always ready to find a solution.
* Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to multitask.
* Excellent negotiation, communication and interpersonal skills.
* Budget management experience.
* Driving license, traveling to various locations as needed.
* Proficiency in Google Suite, AI and team collaboration tools.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* A competitive salary with flexibility based on your experience and skills.
* Access to our discretionary annual bonus of up to 20% based on personal and business performance
* Covered travel expenses to shows
* 11 days PTO plus federal holidays and extra gifted days off at Christmas
* An extra day of annual leave gifted for each year of service (up to an additional 3 days)
* Your birthday off (or a day within the same month)
* Health insurance
* 401k
* Maternity and paternity leave policy
* A flexible hybrid-working policy 3 days in the office and 2 at home or on-site where needed
* Significant opportunities for personal growth and career progression as the business scales.

**About the Company**

Nitrogen Express is a family-owned industrial and specialty gas distribution business. We supply businesses that need gases and related products to keep their operations running. We earn revenue by selling and delivering products and by keeping customers invoiced, collected, and serviced reliably.

**About the Position**

We need one accountable, in-office owner for the company’s day-to-day financial administration and office operating rhythm. The work is important to cash flow, vendor relationships, customer experience, and good decision-making. We want to replace fragmented processes with reliable systems—not just fill a desk.

This is a high-visibility seat in a stable, family-owned business where a capable person can make a real difference. The person will not be stuck doing one narrow transaction all day. They will own meaningful financial workflows, work directly with the owner, improve how the business operates, and build systems that matter. It is an excellent opportunity for someone who is tired of being buried in a large company or limited to a narrow AP/AR silo and wants broader responsibility.

**Responsibilities**

This person should own the day-to-day financial workflows for a small operating business, with appropriate owner review and approval on major decisions and payments.

* Maintain clean, timely QuickBooks Online records and supporting documentation.
* Drive invoicing promptly and accurately; identify missing information before it creates a billing delay.
* Own the accounts-receivable rhythm: aging review, professional customer follow-up, notes, escalation, and collections follow-through.
* Organize accounts payable: receive and code bills, maintain vendor files, prepare a clear weekly payables list, and make sure nothing important is missed. Owner approval remains required for payments.

* Create, document, and maintain practical SOPs for invoicing, collections, payables, customer account setup, and file management.
* Use Excel, QuickBooks, and secure AI-enabled tools thoughtfully to reduce manual work, catch errors, create follow-up drafts, improve reporting, and make processes more reliable.
* Serve as a dependable, professional in-office point of contact for customers, vendors, and the team.

* Identify immediate invoicing, collections, and file-organization gaps.

* Implement a consistent invoice-to-collection process and documented collection cadence.
* Clean up vendor, customer, and supporting-document workflows.
* Create clear SOPs for the highest-risk recurring tasks.
* Present the first practical automation / process-improvement recommendations.

* Success is not just “the books are entered.” The right person makes the financial side of the business feel organized, current, and visible. Invoices go out on time, collections are handled professionally and consistently, vendor obligations are clear, records are easy to find, and the owner can see what needs attention without chasing information.

Qualifications

* At least 3 years of relevant hands-on accounting/finance-office experience.
* Recent hands-on experience with QuickBooks and the end-to-end cycle of invoicing, AR/collections, AP, vendor bills, and financial organization—not only one narrow task in a large department.

Today, Bobrick operates eight manufacturing facilities across the U.S., Canada, the U.K., and India, serving customers in over 125 countries worldwide.

**Job Summary**

The Marketing Communications and Design Specialist creates and maintains technical collateral and digital product content for Bobrick Washroom Accessories, Bobrick Toilet Partitions, Koala Kare, and GAMCO. This role combines graphic design with accurate content management to support product launches and marketing initiatives.

Working with Product Management, Digital Marketing, the Marketing Communications team, and vendors, the specialist delivers clear, approved materials that meet brand standards and deadlines. The specialist also develops and maintains website and email components using HTML and CSS, translating approved designs into responsive digital content and resolving routine front-end issues across Bobrick’s digital platforms.

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

*Technical product communications*

* Create, revise, and maintain technical data sheets, installation instructions, customer service documents, service and parts manuals, technical bulletins, maintenance guides, product labels, carton imprint layouts, country of origin documentation, warranties, and short and long form guide specifications.
* Coordinate technical reviews and approvals with Product Management.

*Graphic design and production*

* Design and format technical collateral; update existing sell sheets, brochures, continuing education presentations, and training materials; and produce business cards using approved templates.
* Apply sound typography, layout, and visual hierarchy to make materials clear and consistent with brand standards.
* Edit and prepare product imagery for print and digital use.

*Product launch support*

* Follow established launch processes and checklists to coordinate required collateral, product information, images, specifications, and digital assets.
* Track deliverables, reviews, and approvals to meet launch timelines.

*Website content and product resources*

* Build and maintain product pages, landing pages, and reusable content components in WordPress or the applicable content management system
* Write and modify HTML and CSS to implement approved designs, create responsive layouts, and resolve routine front-end issues.
* Test changes across browsers and screen sizes, check accessibility and functionality, and document and escalate changes that require developer support.
* Keep approved copy, imagery, downloads, and links current across brand websites, Bobrick Resources, the Technical Reference Library, and ATS/Bobrick Digital Spec Builder.
* Add or replace approved assets and coordinate removal of obsolete or discontinued product content.

*BIM and CAD coordination*

* Coordinate requests, revisions, reviews, approvals, and publication of Revit (.rfa) and CAD (.dwg) files.
* Work with Product Managers and technical vendors to maintain accurate, organized product assets.

*Email marketing*

* Build, maintain, and troubleshoot HubSpot email templates using HTML and inline CSS.
* Adapt templates for campaign needs, prepare mailing lists, and support trade show and other marketing campaigns.
* Test formatting across desktop and mobile devices, and check links and content before deployment in coordination with Digital Marketing.

*Translations and print production*

* Coordinate translation requests, vendor revisions, and internal reviews; incorporate approved translations into print and digital materials.
* Manage collateral reprints with print vendors, checking artwork, proofs, and file versions before production.

*Project coordination and quality control*

* Manage concurrent assignments, maintain organized source files and version control, and check accuracy and brand consistency before publication.
* Adapt communications to architects, designers, specifiers, facility managers, and distributors.
* Resolve routine issues and escalate technical questions or conflicting priorities to the appropriate lead.

*Tools and team support*

* Use approved AI tools to support drafting, editing, and workflow efficiency, with human review and compliance with company policies.
* Collaborate on special marketing projects and other assigned duties.
* Maintain a safe work environment and report unsafe conditions.

**Qualifications**

*Education and Experience*

* A bachelor’s degree in graphic design, marketing, communications, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience.
* Hands-on experience in marketing communications, graphic design or production design, with demonstrated ability to create polished print and digital materials.
* A portfolio demonstrating layout, typography, image editing, and consistent application of brand standards. Examples of product collateral, technical documents, or digital marketing assets are especially relevant.

*Required Skills*

* Proficiency in Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop, including document layout, image preparation, and production of print-ready and digital files.
* Ability to translate detailed product information into clear, readable materials and adapt established designs for different formats and audiences.
* Proficiency in writing and modifying HTML and CSS to build responsive website content and email templates, implement approved designs, and diagnose and resolve routine layout and styling issues.
* Experience publishing and maintaining content in WordPress or a comparable content management system, and building and editing email templates in HubSpot or a comp

new_jobs.description:
**PART-TIME • HOURLY BASE PAY + COMMISSION • OPPORTUNITY TO GROW INTO FULL-TIME**

Northwest LK Media & Signage is hiring an Outside Sales Representative to help local businesses with commercial signs, graphics, printing, branded spaces and trade show displays, as well as related marketing and video projects.

PAY & WORK ARRANGEMENT

* Base pay: $20–$36 per hour, based on experience and qualifications, plus additional commission on closed sales.

* Part-time: approximately 16–20 hours per week, Monday–Friday, coordinated around outreach, client meetings and business events.

The Program Coordinator leads day-to-day planning, implementation, and documentation of Eden Youth’s integrated youth substance use prevention portfolio, including scheduling and partnerships with districts and school sites. The Coordinator aligns program delivery with school calendars, grant requirements, evaluation protocols, and the Senior Program Manager’s priorities, and incorporates youth voice throughout. The position also supervises, trains, and coaches facilitators and peer educators. This is a prevention role; it does not provide substance use disorder diagnosis or clinical treatment.

**School partnerships and implementation**

Serve as the primary liaison between schools, districts, staff, and community partners to coordinate program planning, approvals, scheduling, referrals, and implementation. Maintain site trackers to monitor attendance, program delivery, evaluations, staffing, challenges, and follow-up actions while supporting partnership agreements and renewals.

**Stanford REACH Lab curricula and appropriate intervention**

Coordinate the effective delivery of Stanford REACH Lab substance-use prevention curricula, including cannabis, vaping, opioid/fentanyl awareness, and alternatives to suspension. Schedule and support trained educators, monitor curriculum fidelity, and address implementation concerns. Collaborate with school teams to manage referrals, ensure confidential student support, and coordinate pre/post-surveys using approved Stanford data collection tools.

**Friday Night Live and youth leadership**

Coordinate Friday Night Live (FNL) chapters, youth leadership meetings, prevention campaigns, and school activities while promoting youth participation and ownership. Collaborate with the Youth Advisory Council (YAC) on youth-led projects, community outreach, and advocacy. Train and mentor youth leaders in communication, project planning, inclusive leadership, prevention messaging, and responsible reporting.

Ensure county-funded program requirements are met and documented separately from other funded activities.

The Customer Success team helps customers turn Everlaw's powerful technology into meaningful outcomes on their most important matters. **Location:** HQ - Williamsburg, Brooklyn

**Status:** Full-time/100% on-site

**Compensation:** $65,000-$75,000 annually

  

**Position Summary:**

Kith is seeking an IT Project & Operations Coordinator to support the execution of technology initiatives across our

retail, corporate, and e-commerce operations. This role sits at the intersection of project coordination and day-to-

day IT operations, with a strong emphasis on supporting new store openings and construction build-outs -

coordinating technology deployment timelines, vendors, and on-site readiness alongside the IT team. The ideal

candidate is organized, proactive, detail oriented, and comfortable working across construction schedules, vendor

relationships, and ticketing/operations systems in a fast-paced retail environment.

  

**Responsibilities**

**Store Construction & Rollout Coordination**

* Serve as the primary IT point of contact for new store openings and remodels, coordinating technology scope, timelines, and readiness from construction kickoff through opening.
* Partner with construction project managers, general contractors, and low-voltage/cabling vendors to schedule and track IT-related build-out milestones.
* Coordinate procurement and shipping of store IT hardware to align with construction and opening timelines.
* Track multiple concurrent projects (e.g., new openings, remodels) in a shared project tracker, flagging schedule risks and escalating blockers to the Director of IT.
* Conduct or coordinate pre-opening technology walkthroughs and punch-list resolution on-site or remotely.
Create/maintain documentation of store IT infrastructure standards, site-specific configurations, and lessons learned across openings.  

  

**IT Operations Support**

* Coordinate vendor relationships and purchase orders for hardware, networking, and telecom, in support of both retail and corporate needs.
* Assist with asset lifecycle tracking - procurement, deployment, inventory, and retirement of IT equipment.
Help maintain internal documentation, knowledge base articles, and the roles & responsibilities resource hub.  

  

**Project & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Build and maintain project plans, status reports, and timelines for IT initiatives; run recurring status check-ins with stakeholders.
* Coordinate across IT, Construction, Facilities, Finance, and Operations departments to keep technology workstreams aligned with broader store and business goals and timelines.
Prepare status updates and summaries for IT leadership on active projects, risks, and dependencies.  

  

**Qualifications**

* 2–5 years of experience in project coordination, IT operations, or a similar role – IT, retail, and construction-adjacent experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating timelines across multiple projects with multiple stakeholders (vendors, contractors, internal teams).
* Familiarity with networking fundamentals strongly preferred, sufficient to coordinate with vendors and technicians - hands-on experience not required.
* Comfortable using ITSM/ticketing platforms, project trackers, and standard productivity tools (Google Workspace preferred).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate technical timelines for non-technical stakeholders.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple concurrent projects with competing deadlines.
* Excellent follow through skills and “stay-on-top” of things attitude.
Willingness to travel periodically to store locations for on-site coordination and openings.  

  

**Preferred (Nice to Have)**

PMP, CAPM, or equivalent project coordination training/certification.  

  

**WHO WE ARE**

Established in 2011 in New York City, Kith is a lifestyle brand and specialty retailer that offers seasonal collections of men’s, women’s and children’s apparel, accessories and footwear through a distinct lens of personal storytelling. Led by Founder, CEO and Creative Director Ronnie Fieg, the brand is known globally for evoking nostalgia from a dynamic point of view, and working closely with a carefully selected set of best-in-class collaborators.

  

Kith operates 16 standalone boutiques around the world, and 3 shop-in-shops. Kith Treats, conceived from Fieg’s childhood love for cereal, operates in 10 locations, as well as Sadelle’s at Kith restaurants in Paris, Miami Design District, Toronto and Seoul.

**About Daysee**

Daysee is a new family photography studio in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, founded by two local moms who believe family photography should feel beautiful, natural, and genuinely fun.

We're building something a little different. A modern photography studio with an editorial eye, a playful spirit, and a love for documenting the little moments that make family life special.

We're looking for a creative, social-media-native person to help bring the Daysee world to life online.

**The Role**

We're looking for someone who lives and breathes social media, has an exceptional visual eye, and knows how to create content that feels engaging, authentic, and worth following.

You'll work closely with our founders to help develop and execute our social content, create engaging Reels, curate our Instagram grid, and build relationships with our growing community.

We're particularly interested in someone with a background or strong interest in photography, creative direction, fashion, design, children and family brands, or editorial content.

Our goal is to make our social presence feel less like advertising and more like a visual journal of the people, stories, and moments that make Daysee special.

**What You'll Do**

* **Content Creation:** Create and edit engaging Instagram Reels, Stories, and posts using our professional photography and video content.
* **Grid Planning & Curation:** Help plan and maintain a beautiful, cohesive Instagram grid with a strong editorial aesthetic.
* **Community Engagement:** Build genuine relationships with our followers, local businesses, creators, and relevant NYC communities through thoughtful, proactive engagement.
* **Content Planning:** Help develop and manage a monthly content calendar, ensuring a consistent and thoughtful social presence.
* **Campaign Support:** Support creative planning and content execution for seasonal launches, studio events, collaborations, and promotions.
* **Creative Ideas:** Bring fresh ideas, emerging trends, storytelling concepts, and new content formats that feel relevant to our brand.
* **Performance Insights:** Track basic social performance and help identify what's resonating with our audience.

**Who We're Looking For**

* You're genuinely social-media-native and understand what makes content perform on Instagram and TikTok.
* You have a strong visual eye and appreciation for photography, composition, typography, and editorial design.
* You're confident creating and editing short-form videos, particularly Instagram Reels.
* You're familiar with tools such as CapCut, Canva, Later, Planoly, or similar.
* You understand how to build organic engagement and genuine community connections.
* You're organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently.
* You're a strong communicator who can translate creative direction into polished content.
* You have experience creating content for a brand, creative business, or your own social channels.

**Bonus points if:**

* You have a background in photography, fashion, design, editorial, or another creative field.
* You're based in Brooklyn or NYC.
* You're a photographer or content creator yourself.
* You've helped grow an Instagram account organically.
* You have experience working with lifestyle, family, or hospitality brands.

Working With Us

This is a flexible, part-time role at $30 per hour, averaging approximately 7–8 hours per week.

You'll work closely with our founders on creative direction, with the opportunity to take ownership of social content execution, community engagement, and ongoing content planning.

We'll provide access to our professional photography, video footage, brand assets, and upcoming campaign plans. We're looking for someone who can take these materials and turn them into thoughtful, engaging content, while bringing their own ideas and creative perspective.

As a small, growing business, we value creativity, initiative, collaboration, and people who genuinely care about the work they put into the world.

* Examples of Instagram accounts you've worked on or content you've created, especially Reels.

**Instagram:** @dayseestudio

**Circuit Clinical®** is on a mission to transform how people find, choose, and participate in clinical research. We are challenging the historical clinical trial methodologies through our work focused on improving access and inclusion in community-based healthcare and through our services that unburden the patients and principal investigators participating in research.

We seek a full-time **Research Coordinator** to join our Team!

As an emerging startup in Buffalo, where New York state fosters rapid and robust growth within the startup community, Circuit Clinical was ranked 20th nationally for Best Workplaces for Innovators by Fast Company® and was named an Inc. Magazine® Best Workplaces 2021. Circuit’s accolades continued beyond the early years as a research industry watchlist company, including winning SCOPE’s Participant Engagement Award in 2022 while continuing to receive national recognition as Fast Company’s World Changing Ideas™ Award 2022. Over the past year, Circuit has remained committed to breaking the norms that have challenged research participation and continues to extend reach within the research industry, having expanded client relationships with multiple pharmaceutical companies and contract research organizations. And we are not done yet. Our growth knows no bounds as we extended our community-based research into the Midwest during 2023 while growing our remote research capabilities across all 50 US states.

Our award-winning culture is grounded in our values, the heart of the Circuit ethos. We focus on building an incredible, hard-charging **Team** and providing them the opportunity to do the best work of their careers. In short, we’re motivated to take on the most challenging problems in developing new medicines – this is work that matters to us and those we serve, the patients.

We must recruit the industry’s most dynamic, mission-driven, empathetic, and passionate leaders to accomplish our mission. That’s where you come in!

**What We Offer**

Suppose you’ve been looking for a chance to work with a unique, highly motivated **Team** and to have a direct impact in building a transformative clinical trials company every day. In that case, that is precisely what we’re offering. We provide competitive benefits and an environment focused on helping you grow personally and professionally.

**What You Will Bring to Our Team**

As our **Research Coordinator** you will be responsible for coordinating, facilitating, and monitoring the implementation of research study protocols being conducted in accordance with departmental policy, institutional policy, sponsor requirements, and FDA regulations. You will also provide, manage, and coordinate care for patients participating in clinical trials in compliance with written study protocols. You will report to the VP, Site Operations and work in collaboration with the Clinical Operations, Regulatory, and Business Development teams.

**Specific responsibilities include:**

* Having thorough knowledge of study protocol, including inclusion and exclusion criteria and confirmation of subject eligibility
* Knowledge of study endpoints, reportable events (Adverse Event, Serious Adverse Event, Adverse Events of Special Interest)
* Knowledge of disease process and standard of care
* Completion of study screen tool and study summary
* Defining methods of subject identification and recruitment
* Thorough knowledge of protocol to conduct Informed Consent Form process
* Completion of screening procedures, randomization, and subject visits
* Investigational Product dispensing and accountability
* Scheduling of study visits in compliance with protocol(s)
* Preparation and maintenance of source documents and IRB submitted documents for recruitment
* Assisting in recruitment efforts, contacting and identifying potentially eligible participants to screen
* Confirming Primary Investigator review of study visits
* Reviewing Adverse Events and Serious Adverse Event with Primary Investigator within 24 hour of event report to Institutional Review Board (IRB) and sponsor
* Subject retention activities and follow up procedures
* Obtaining consents for amendments where applicable
* Participating in protocol amendment training and updates essential documents accordingly
* Sponsoring monitoring activities, preparation, data clarification
* Weekly review of study status
* Obtaining appropriate certification of required trainings
* Contributing to patient recruitment efforts as business demands require.
* Additional duties as assigned.

**Your qualifications include:**

* Licensed as a registered nurse (RN), certified Medical Assistant, or licensed practical nurse (LPN), required
* Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Minimum 1-3 years experience in Clinical Research required
* Reliable transportation is required
* Computer literacy including Microsoft office (Word, Excel), Google suite, and CTMS software a plus.

**What Makes You a Good Candidate**

* You are proactive. When problems arise, you think through them logically and with clarity, surface them rapidly and collaborate to resolve them swiftly.
* You are results oriented and see projects through to the finish line without losing momentum – you are comfortable connecting with others at all levels of the organization to help drive a culture of accountability and performance.
* You are an excellent communicator, both verbally and written. You will need to clearly articulate the business, vendor and customer needs and provide status updates to leadership.
* You like to ask questions. You understand the need to obtain drilled down details to have smooth operating success. You can live in those details without losing sight of the bigger picture and the result.

**An inclusive work environment is an empowering one. At Cutover, we lead with empathy and enable others to succeed through curiosity, kindness, and self-expression.**

**Location**: This role is flexible in location, but we would expect you to be able to commute to our NYC office on a weekly basis.

**We regret that we are unable to provide sponsorships at this time.**

Cutover provides enterprise technology operations teams with an AI-powered SaaS solution that automates and streamlines complex processes with intelligent runbooks. The Cutover solution enables teams to respond to incidents quickly, recover from IT outages, and manage cloud migrations with precision and efficiency. Cutover is used in many of the world's largest financial institutions to support their critical technology operations, including 5 out of the top 6 largest asset managers and 3 out of the top 5 US banks.

We're excited to grow our Customer Success team with some more energetic and growth-minded Customer Success talent. From initial onboarding to ongoing adoption, our Customer Success Managers assist customers throughout their lifecycle, helping them unlock maximum value from our platform and services. We have a keen focus on driving Monthly Active User ("MAU") growth within our key accounts, as well as focusing on the overall account health by using a data driven approach to unlock value and resolve issues in a proactive manner. Our Customer Success Managers bring energy, creativity and a strong sense of product evangelism to their day-to-day work. We understand our customers' strategy, vision and goals and - as trusted advisors - recommend solutions, enabling them to use the full power of the Cutover platform to bring vision to reality.

This role is ideal for a Customer Success Manager at an early-to-mid career stage who has experience supporting enterprise customers and is looking to deepen their technical, product, and advisory skillset in a fast-growing SaaS environment.

**What we'd like you to bring to the table for this role...**

* 2-4 years of experience in a financial services customer-facing role, ideally in Customer Success.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to manage multiple client projects, identify process gaps, and adapt to technical complexity.
* Technically proficient with modern SaaS tools, a willingness to master the Cutover platform, and innate interest in cloud and AI.
* A balanced approach to customer success, focused on maximizing platform usage and value while collaborating with internal teams to minimize churn and drive growth.
* Strong relationship-building skills across all levels of enterprise organizations, adept at running data-informed business reviews, and a passionate customer advocate.

**The good stuff…**

* We're excited to offer **Share Options** as part of our compensation package.
* **20 days of PTO per year + public holidays**, and we want you to take all of them!
* **3 volunteer days** to use for any charitable/voluntary cause you would like.
* A top-tier private health insurance package.
* 401k contribution plan
* **Work from home stipends**
* A **personal learning and development budget** through Learnerbly. You'll be supported in your quest for knowledge, whatever that looks like to you.
* If you're thinking of starting or growing your family, then you'll be in great company - more than half of our team are parents and we've built a globally consistent parental leave approach that we're proud of.
* Employee Referral Scheme.
* Safeguarding the mental health of our teams is paramount for us. If you'd like to, then you'll be able to avail yourself of **multiple Cutover mental health initiatives**, from fully subsidized therapy sessions to subscriptions to leading wellbeing platforms.

**Target compensation package:** $100,000 - $120,000 base, $25,000 - $30,000 variable + stock options + benefits.

The final offer may vary from the target compensation package, taking into consideration factors such as your experience level and skill set. If we aren't aligned on salary at this stage, we'd still love to hear from you to better understand if there are more suitable opportunities at Cutover.

**Diversity Statement - Empowering Our Teams**

We encourage our team to bring their authentic selves to work, which we have found has strengthened workplace relationships and fostered a genuine sense of community.

*If you are excited by this role, we invite you to apply!* Even if your profile doesn't check all the boxes, please don't simply scroll past! We recognize that talent lies everywhere and that some demographic groups are more likely to apply for a "stretch role" than others. We are always open to different perspectives and professional backgrounds to keep Cutover's culture evolving and to ensure that we never stop learning.

Cutover is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Maintaining an equitable hiring process is imperative to our mission. All applicants are considered without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, mental or physical disability, marital status, protected veteran or parental status.

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (SMB)
new_jobs.description:
Vendelux is building the category-defining platform for event marketing intelligence.

Events are one of the largest and most impactful marketing channels, yet historically one of the least measurable. Vendelux brings transparency and performance to this space — helping companies discover, evaluate, and optimize their event strategy with data.

Our platform powers thousands of event decisions by delivering proprietary, AI-driven insights across hundreds of thousands of events globally. At the core of our platform is a robust ecosystem of event organizer partnerships — where organizers share first-party data, enabling richer insights for customers while receiving benchmarking and audience intelligence in return. From identifying the highest ROI conferences to enabling targeted meeting programs, Vendelux helps companies turn events into a predictable and scalable growth engine.

In addition, Vendelux Meetings extends our platform by turning insights into pipeline — using AI to identify high-value attendees and proactively book 1:1 meetings between our customers and their ideal prospects at events. This enables go-to-market teams to drive measurable ROI and maximize every event interaction.

Founded in 2021, Vendelux is a Series B SaaS company backed by top-tier investors including FirstMark. We partner with many of the fastest-growing companies in the world, and our team includes leaders from Bain, ZoomInfo, Shutterstock, FanDuel, Compass, Airbnb, Forter and beyond.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

We're looking for a Customer Success Manager (SMB) who has been in the trenches of a high-growth B2B SaaS company, knows what it takes to manage a complex book of business, and is excited by the opportunity to help shape how we do Customer Success at Vendelux. If you thrive in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment and love the challenge of turning at-risk accounts into long-term champions, we want to talk.

This role is hybrid, 4 days a week in our NYC office.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Function as a true account manager across the full customer lifecycle — from onboarding and enablement through renewals, upsells, and negotiations
* Own a portfolio of accounts simultaneously, managing competing priorities with urgency and precision — expect to juggle 9+ active workstreams at any given time
* Lead structured onboarding and training programs that drive fast time-to-value and long-term product adoption
* Run proactive meeting campaigns and renewal processes, ensuring no account goes dark or falls through the cracks
* Negotiate renewals and expansions with confidence, building strong business cases that demonstrate clear ROI
* **Drive retention with a relentless, creative approach — exhaust every option before accepting churn, whether that's a LinkedIn message, an in-person office visit, a free pilot extension, or bringing in leadership to save the relationship**
* Travel to customer sites a minimum of 2 days per month to strengthen relationships and accelerate outcomes
* Contribute to community building across the customer base through webinars, case studies, and events

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 2+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a hybrid of both — ideally at a B2B SaaS or high-growth tech company
* Proven track record of owning the full client lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, renewals, upsells, and negotiations
* Thrives in a fast-paced environment managing multiple high-priority accounts simultaneously without dropping the ball
* Relentless when it comes to retention — you get creative, you show up, and you don't give up on an account easily
* Comfortable traveling to meet customers in person and building face-to-face relationships
* Highly accountable self-starter who doesn't need to be chased for updates
* Strong communicator who can navigate difficult conversations with customers and internal stakeholders alike

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive base salary and bonus
* Equity
* Healthcare covering medical, dental and vision
* 401(k)
* Catered lunch every day in our NYC office
* Unlimited PTO plus two company-wide shutdowns during the July 4th week and the Christmas – New Year's week

Not all candidates will check all of the requirements listed above and that’s ok! We are open to great people from non-traditional backgrounds.

Vendelux is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

Compensation Range: $120K - $140K
