new_jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
new_jobs.description:
**First Batch–Digital Marketing Manager**

The First Batch wineries create magic for our guests every day, whether that's bringing a dream wedding to life, creating a delicious new dish to pair with our wine, or helping people discover a new passion on one of our winery tours. We do this with an approachable, warm, inclusive, down-to-earth attitude that reflects our passion for bringing traditional winemaking into urban centers, so people don't have to travel to experience the magic of winemaking.

We are looking for team members who care deeply about creating a friendly, warm experience for our guests and for each other. People who love food, wine and events, and who love to learn, share, and tell others about their stories and adventures.

**Position Summary**

The Digital Marketing Manager is primarily responsible for all digital advertising efforts. This includes not only the programming of paid digital advertising campaigns, but tracking their efficacy, analyzing data, preparing reports, building and optimizing landing pages, and ensuring website content is created and optimized to convert leads.

**Core Responsibilities**

Digital Advertising:

* Paid ad creation & management on platforms including but not limited to Google, Meta, Reddit, Bing.
* Collaborate with Creative Marketing Manager to ensure content and content deployment on organic channels aligns & supports paid strategies and to utilize any high performing organic content.
* Conduct paid search governance by conducting daily, weekly, and monthly audits of paid ads infrastructure, ensuring flawless tracking, clean campaign hierarchy, and optimal budget allocation.
* Mitigate against wasted spend by actively managing search term reports to identify, build, and maintain robust negative keyword lists, routinely reducing cost-per-acquisition (CPA).
* Optimize creative assets via routine audits and A/B testing ad creatives, copy variants, and asset extensions (sitelinks, images, promotions) to maximize click through rate, lead conversion, and quality scores.
* Monitor and guide Google’s smart bidding and performance max algorithms by auditing conversion signals, audience inputs, and target KPIs regularly.
* Ownership of all SEO & GEO efforts including ranking and citations.
* Responsible for tracking all platform changes including core updates, new features, and testing any new AI/Agentic tools.

Data, Analytics, and Strategic Forecasting:

* Maintain ongoing, deep analysis of campaign data; have a "finger on the pulse" of the advertising engine at all times to instantly catch anomalies or scale wins.
* Own the weekly update of the results dashboard (Google Sheets) and synthesize complex data into clear, actionable quarterly performance reports for the executive team.
* Champion data hygiene by routinely auditing conversion tracking, UTM tagging, and GA4 integration to ensure 100% accurate attribution.
* Translate raw metrics into a cohesive strategic approach for paid advertising, ensuring daily and weekly optimization tactics align with high- level business goals.
* Analyze historical performance data and market trends to feed into the annual marketing plan, establishing realistic KPIs and tactical roadmaps to hit company growth objectives.
* Formulate and execute a continuous A/B testing framework (for creative, copy, and landing pages), using performance data to foster a culture of constant optimization.

Website Landing Page & UX Optimization:

* Ensure Ad-to-Page alignment. Design, launch, and manage high-converting landing pages specifically tailored to paid ad campaigns, ensuring an intuitive user experience (UX) from click to conversion.
* Maximize quality score & ad rank by building landing pages optimized for Google’s core ranking factors—maximizing Relevance, Expected Click-Through Rate, and Landing Page Experience to lower Cost-Per-Click (CPC) and boost Ad Rank.
* Boost AI & Search Engine Readability. Partner with our web developers to structure website content, technical metadata, and on-page schema so it is effortlessly crawled, understood, and surfaced by Google’s AI search models and algorithms.
* Improve conversion rate optimization through running continuous A/B and multivariate tests on landing pages (testing headlines, layouts, form lengths, and CTAs) to systematically improve conversion rates.
* Monitor core web vitals & technical health by collaborating with our web developers to ensure landing pages load instantly, feature seamless mobile responsiveness, and meet Google’s stringent page-speed performance benchmarks.
* Ensure all new landing pages and web assets are properly instrumented with Google Tag Manager, heatmaps, and event-tracking pixels before launching campaigns.
* Create website content that meets EEAT standards & converts website visitors into leads.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in paid digital advertising across platforms like Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Meta, and Reddit.
* Google Analytics and Google Ads certified
* High software literacy - the ability to quickly learn and adapt to new/different software systems such as website CMS, CRMs, Project Management software, AI tools, etc.
* Experience supporting a multi-faceted business model that includes multiple verticals
* Wine and hospitality experience desired but not required
* Experience working in Google Suite, especially Drive, Sheets and Docs
* Proficient in Excel
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to present information clearly and concisely
* Accurate and consistent work with exceptional attention to detail
* Self-starter attitude, willingness and eagerness to learn
* Ability to confidently work autonomously and with varying levels of adaptability amidst changing priorities

**Essential Duties**

* Ability to travel amongst our three locations
* Must be able to lift up to 30 pounds
* Must be on property 1-2 days a week
* Frequent walking, standing, or moving between departments or

**8:30 A.M – 4:30 P.M**

**Who We Are**
==============

DoubleVerify is a leading software platform for digital media measurement, data and analytics. DV’s mission is to be the definitive source of transparency and data-driven insights into the quality and effectiveness of digital advertising for the world’s largest brands, publishers and digital ad platforms. DV’s technology platform provides advertisers with consistent and unbiased data and analytics that can be used to optimize the quality and return on their digital ad investments. Since 2008, DV has helped hundreds of Fortune 500 companies gain the most from their media spend by delivering best in class solutions across the digital advertising ecosystem, helping to build a better industry. Learn more at www.doubleverify.com.

DoubleVerify is adding a Sales Development Representative to the Commercial team to accelerate account growth and pipeline generation across the business. This role sits at the intersection of Sales and Marketing and carries three responsibilities: expanding existing agency and brand-direct relationships, building qualified pipelines for the Growth & Ignition Mid-Market, New Business, Performance, and Strategic Accounts sales teams, and converting inbound interest into closed revenue on smaller services deals.

**What You'll Do**
==================

You will work daily with Client Partners and Enterprise Sales Directors across DoubleVerify's sales teams, and partner closely with Marketing to turn signals into meetings and meetings into opportunities. This is a highly visible, cross-functional role for someone who wants exposure to the full breadth of DV's commercial organization while building toward a closing sales seat.

**Expand accounts and open new doors**
--------------------------------------

  

* Map stakeholders beyond the current point of contact inside existing agency (holding company and independent) and brand-direct accounts
* Identify and open conversations with new buying centers and teams inside current client organizations to widen DoubleVerify's footprint
* Partner with Client Partners to surface upsell and cross-sell opportunities where clients are not yet using the full DV platform

**Build pipeline across sales teams**
-------------------------------------

  

* Generate qualified opportunities for the G&I Mid-Market, New Business, Performance, and Strategic Accounts sales teams through multi-channel outbound: email, calls, LinkedIn, and other prospecting channels
* Research target accounts, identify decision-makers, and personalize outreach using DoubleVerify's sales and AI tools
* Partner with Marketing on lead follow-up, campaign execution, and event outreach
* Keep prospecting activity, qualification notes, and opportunity status current in Salesforce

**Qualify inbound leads and close smaller deals**
-------------------------------------------------

  

* Respond to and qualify inbound leads generated by Marketing, and route strategic opportunities to the appropriate Enterprise Sales Director
* Own and close smaller services deals directly, from qualification through signature
* Run discovery calls to confirm fit and need before handoff or close
* Track qualification criteria, conversion rates, and inbound funnel performance, and report results to Sales leadership

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

  

* 1 to 3 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, or lead generation, ideally in digital media, ad tech, or SaaS
* A track record of meeting or exceeding pipeline, qualification, or quota targets
* Comfort with heavy outbound activity, including cold calling, email prospecting, and social selling
* Working knowledge of a modern sales stack (Salesforce or a comparable CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, sales engagement tools) and familiarity with AI tools for research and personalization
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain DoubleVerify's value proposition clearly to media and marketing buyers
* A process-oriented, data-driven approach to prospecting and account planning
* A collaborative mindset and the ambition to grow into a closing sales role at DoubleVerify
* Based in or willing to work from New York, NY

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on a number of non-discriminating factors, including qualifications for the role, level, skills, experience, location, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at DV. The estimated salary range for this role based on the qualifications set forth in the job description is between $69,000 to $101,000. This role will also be eligible for bonus/commission (as applicable), equity, and benefits. The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description; however, we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be more or less experienced than this job description as posted.

Not-so-fun fact: Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of job criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you have what it takes but you’re not sure that you check every box, apply anyway!

They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something.  
  
Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities with over 100 million meals served and continue to grow rapidly.  
  
Powered by technology and a network of 3,500+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. new_jobs.title: Business Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
Endeavor is real-world enterprise AI.

AI models are improving faster than most companies can put them to work. Endeavor closes that gap.

We exist to secure American industrial leadership. AI is the largest advantage available to the companies that make, move, and defend things in this country, and most of them can't reach it alone. We close that distance — so their customers pay less, their people do work worth doing, and the companies themselves come out stronger than the competition abroad.

To do that, we build custom AI systems for companies in mission-critical industries — manufacturing, distribution, supply chain, defense, life sciences. Not software they rent from a vendor that doesn't understand their business. Systems they own, built inside their own stack, in production in weeks.

Operating Principles

* One team, one fight. Small companies fail for a hundred reasons. Being internally misaligned shouldn't be one of them. We think like owners of the whole business — the question is always how *we* win. We're fighting the world, not each other.
* Strong convictions, loosely held. Show up with a point of view and hold that view loosely enough that better evidence can move it. The best ideas come from candor and debate.
* Default to open. Our clients trust us with their hardest problems and we extend that same trust internally. Information here is open by default — data, context, the reasoning behind decisions — because you can't own an outcome you can only see half of.

The Role | Business Development Representative

As a Business Development Representative, you will identify and qualify new business opportunities, generate leads, and build relationships with potential clients. You will collaborate closely with the sales team to develop strategies, set up meetings, and ensure successful handoffs of qualified leads for closing. Your role will require consistent communication, client outreach, and an ability to effectively present and tailor solutions to fit client needs.

What We Require

* Genuine curiosity about the customer. You research the market, form a point of view, and bring it to the call instead of reciting a script.
* Comfort with a half-built playbook. Ours isn't finished. You'd rather help write it than wait for it, and you can move with 70% of the information and correct as you learn.
* Self-direction. You set your own pace, flag what's working and what isn't, and ask for help early instead of quietly stalling.
* A teammate people want on their accounts. You share what's working, take direct feedback without getting defensive, and make the AEs and marketers around you better.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is preferred.

Compensation: $70,000 base salary plus commission with an OTE of $100,000+.

Compensation Range: $70K

new_jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Assistant Community Manager plays a critical operational and compliance leadership role, supporting the Community Manager in the administrative, financial, and physical management of the property. Serving as an intentional career pathway toward property leadership, this position holds primary accountability for recertification management and regulatory compliance while actively assisting with daily office operations, rent collection, leasing, and resident relations. The Assistant Community Manager ensures the property operates efficiently, meets all contractual and affordable housing guidelines, and upholds high standards of customer service and mission-driven housing stability.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Compliance and Recertification [40%]**

* Own the resident recertification caseload, ensuring all annual and interim recertifications, gross rent changes, and unit transfers are completed accurately and within mandatory timeframes.
* Conduct applicant and participant interviews, gather third-party verifications, complete calculations, and prepare thorough, audit-ready compliance packages.
* Maintain compliance across all financing layers, including Section 42 (LIHTC), HUD, HOME, PBRA, Bonds, FHLB, and Section 811.
* Maintain electronic and physical resident files in strict adherence to data security, Fair Housing, ADA, and auditing standards.
* Coordinate directly with state housing finance agencies, compliance auditors, and third-party monitoring groups.

**Site Administration [30%]**

* Support the Community Manager with daily administrative workflows, serving as the acting manager in their absence.
* Assist with rent collections, daily bank deposits, ledger adjustments, and delinquent account follow-ups in accordance with local tenant laws.
* Draft and distribute general notices, lease violation notices, and legal documentation utilizing eviction-prevention and de-escalation strategies.
* Assist the Community Manager with accounts payable, invoice processing, and variance tracking.
* Maintain office organization, logs, reports, and administrative supply inventories.

**Resident Relations [15%]**

* Serve as an escalation point for resident disputes, lease violations, and complex inquiries routed from the front desk.
* Educate residents on lease terms, program obligations, and recertification deadlines.
* Partner collaboratively with on-site service providers to process reasonable accommodations and support resident retention.

**Leasing and Maintenance [15%]**

* Process housing applications, maintain the property waitlist, verify eligibility, and execute initial lease signings.
* Monitor the Yardi service request dashboard to track ticket aging, conduct QA on completed tickets, and manage the administrative workflow for unit turns alongside the maintenance team.
* Assist with move-in/move-out inspections, annual unit inspections, and monitoring unit turnover readiness.

**REQUIRED SKILLS AND ABILITIES**

* Deep knowledge of affordable housing policies, HUD guidelines, and LIHTC compliance procedures.
* Proficiency in Yardi Voyager (or equivalent property management software) and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).
* Strong organizational, mathematical, and analytical skills with rigorous attention to detail.
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with proven de-escalation ability.
* Ability to handle multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced environment.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* 2+ years of affordable housing property management experience, with direct experience processing recertifications.
* Valid driver’s license, auto insurance, and reliable transportation.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Tax Credit Certification (e.g., TCS, COS, HCCP, or BOS) or required within 120 days of hire.
* Prior experience with Permanent Supportive Housing (PSH) and vulnerable populations.
* Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Real Estate, or related field.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

* Occasionally requires moving materials weighing up to 20 lbs.
* Unit and property inspections require walking, stair climbing, and general facility navigation.
